source_text: For decades, Hollywood has perpetuated the stereotype of the ideal wife as a beautiful, submissive, and domestic woman who puts her husband and children first.

source_text: For example, a study by the Geena Davis Institute found that in the top 100 films of 2017, only 30% of female characters had speaking roles, and only 12% of those characters were working outside the home.

source_text: The majority of female characters were portrayed as either romantic interests or mothers.

source_text: Instructions:
target_text: Malongi:

source_text: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan.
target_text: 1.Tokisa ntete four na badegre F 350 (badegre 175 C°). Tula manteka mpe farine na ndonga ya gato ke na yinda ya misapi 8 ya ntete ya diboko.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: 2. In a medium bowl, whisk together the flours, granulated sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
target_text: 2. Na katikati ya ndonga ya dibulu, balula kisika mosi farine, sukadi ya mbuma, sukadi ya mbwaki, levire, bicarbonate ya sudi, mpe mungwa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: 3. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and egg until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg yolk and almond extract.
target_text: 3. Na ndonga ya dibulu, tula kisika mosi manteka mpe diki tii yawu kekuma pete mpe ke vwanda na fulu mingi. Bula kisika mosi ndambu ya diki ya mwamba mpe ndambu bame katula na amande.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, alternating with the milk. Mix until just combined.
target_text: 4. Malembe-malembe bwela bisadulu ya kuyuma na bisadulu yina kele ya masa, vingisaka yawu na midiki. Vukisa yawu tii ya ke vukana mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: 5. Fold in the almond flour until evenly distributed.
target_text: 5. Tula yawu na farine ya amande tii yawu ke kumwangana.

source_text: It was a hot summer day in July when I finally turned 16 years old.

source_text: I had been eagerly anticipating this day for as long as I could remember, and now that it was finally here, I couldn't wait to get started on my road to freedom.

source_text: The test was surprisingly easy, and I finished it in no time.

source_text: The next step was to schedule a driving test.

source_text: The day of my driving test arrived, and I was more nervous than I had ever been in my life.

source_text: "Heartbreak," sighed the poet, "is the cruelest of afflictions.

source_text: Kosher foods are those that are considered to be fit for consumption according to Jewish law.

notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The laws of kosher are based on the Torah, the first five books of the Hebrew Bible.
target_text: Misiku me tadila madya ya Casher me katuka na buku ya Torah, buku ya ntete na babuku tanu ya Bibilia ya Kiebeleo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These laws prohibit the consumption of certain animals, such as pigs and shellfish, as well as the consumption of blood and meat from animals that have not been slaughtered in a specific way.
target_text: Misiku yina ke kumanga kudya ya bibulu, mutindu bangulu mpe bambuma ya nzadi ya nene, mutindu madya ya bima ya menga mpe ngombe ya bibulu yina ba kufwana ve na mutindu ya kudelakana.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Kosher foods are also subject to a number of other regulations, such as the separation of dairy and meat products.
target_text: Madya ya Casher me kangama mpe na misiku mingi ya nkana, mutindu kuvambisa midiki na musuni ya ngombe.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Kosher food is prepared in a way that ensures that it is fit for consumption according to Jewish law.
target_text: Ba ke lambaka madya ya Casher na nzila yina ke lakisa ti madya kele mbote na kudya mutindu ke misiku ya Bayudayo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The observance of kosher laws is an important part of Jewish religious practice.
target_text: Kuzitisa madya ya misiku ya Casher kele kitini kele mfunu na nsadulu ya dibundu ya Bayudayo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: For many Jews, eating kosher food is a way to show their devotion to God and to connect with their heritage.
target_text: Samu na Bayudayo mingi, kudya madya ya casher ke nzila na lulakisa kukwikama ya bawu na Nzambi mpe kukangama na kimvwama ya bawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are a number of reasons why Jews observe kosher laws.

notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Some of these reasons are based on religious beliefs, while others are based on practical considerations Religious reasons Jews believe that God gave the Torah to Moses at Mount Sinai.

source_text: Indira Gandhi was the first and only woman to serve as Prime Minister of India.

source_text: She was born in 1917 into a prominent political family, and her father, Jawaharlal Nehru, was the first Prime Minister of India.
target_text: Yandi butukaka na 1917 na dikanda ya nduenga na dyambu ya politiki, mpe tata ya yandi, Jawaharlal Nehru, vandaka Mfumu ta ntete ya Luyalu ya Inde.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Indira Gandhi was educated in India and England, and she married Feroze Gandhi in 1942.

source_text: They had two sons, Rajiv and Sanjay.

source_text: Gandhi began her political career in 1955, when she was elected to the Indian Parliament.

source_text: She served in various ministerial positions in the government of her father, and in 1966 she became Prime Minister after his death.

source_text: Gandhi was a controversial figure, and her policies were often criticized.

source_text: She was accused of being authoritarian and of suppressing dissent.

source_text: However, she was also a popular leader, and she is credited with modernizing India and improving the lives of its people.

source_text: Global warming is the long-term heating of Earth's climate system observed since the pre-industrial period (between 1850 and 1900) due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.
target_text: Tiya ntoto ya mvimba kena nata tiya na mupepe ya Ntoto yina ke na kutalana banda ntangu ya bakompanyi ya ntete (banda 1850 mpe 1900) na kutalaka bisalu ya muntu, ntete tiya ya bima ya mazuti, yina ke kudisaka kitezo ya mupepe ya yimbi kenataka tiya na kizunga nyonso ya Ntoto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The term is frequently used interchangeably with the term climate change, though the latter refers to both human- and naturally produced warming and the effects it has on our planet.
target_text: Ba ke sadilaka mpova yina mutindu mingi na mpova ya kukituka ya mupepe, atako yawu ke lakisa bima zole muntu mpe tiya ntoto kebutaka mpe yimbi na yawu kena mweta.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Since the pre-industrial period, human activities are estimated to have increased Earth's global average temperature by about 1 degree Celsius (1.8 degrees Fahrenheit), a number that is currently increasing by 0.2 degrees Celsius (0.36 degrees Fahrenheit) per decade.
target_text: Banda ntangu ya bakompanyi ya ntete, bisalu ya muntu kudisaka mupepe ya yimbi ya Ntoto na degre 1 ya Celsius (degre Fahrenheit 1.8), ntalu yayi ke na kukula bubu yayi na badegre ya Celsius 0.2 (badegre Fahrenheit 0,36) na bavamvula kumi mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Most of the current warming trend is extremely likely (greater than 95 percent probability) the result of human activity since the 1950s and is proceeding at an unprecedented rate over decades to millennia.
target_text: Tiya ya ntoto ya bubu yayi kena na kukula na mbangu (kukula kulutila lutangu 95 na kati ya nkama) na kutala kisalu ya muntu banda mvula 1950 mpe ke na kusalama na lutangu beto lenda kuteza ve na vamvula kumi ti bamvula ya kulutilamingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The largest human influence on climate change has been the emission of greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide, methane and nitrous oxide.
target_text: Kima nataka nsobolo ya nene na tiya ya ntoto kele kubasika ya mupepe ya yimbi mutindu dioxyde ya carbone, methane mpe oxyde ya nitrate.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The primary source of these emissions is from burning fossil fuels for electricity, heat and transportation.
target_text: Kisika ya ntete katukaka mipepe yayi ya yimbi ke kuyoka ya bazuti samu na kura, tiya mpe kutambula ya kutukutu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist who developed the theory of relativity, one of the two pillars of modern physics (alongside quantum mechanics).
target_text: Albert Einstein vwandaka mwa ya Zamani me longukaka malongi ya physique mpe me kuyidika malongi ya relativite mosi bima zole kele nkinzi na physique (pene na mutindu ya kuteza bima).
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: His work is also known for its influence on the philosophy of science.
target_text: Kisalu ya yandi me kuzabana samu na kisika ya nene yawu me kubaka na luzabu ya filozofi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Einstein is best known in popular culture for his mass–energy equivalence formula E = mc2 (which has been dubbed "the world's most famous equation").
target_text: Einstein me kuzaba mingi na bantu ya ndwenga samu na formule ya yandi kudelakana ya masse-energie E= mc2 (yina ba basisaka kima ya zole "equation me kulutila kuzabana mingi na yinza ya muvimba").
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Einstein was born in Ulm, in the Kingdom of Württemberg, German Empire, on 14 March 1879.
target_text: Einstein butukaka na Ulm, na Kimfumu ya Württemberg, na Kimfumu ya Zamani, na bilumbu 14 na ngonda Marsi mvula 1879.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He showed an early aptitude for mathematics and physics.
target_text: Yandi lakisaka mayele ya yandi na matematiki mpe ya fiziki na bumwana ya yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In 1905, at the age of 26, Einstein published four groundbreaking papers that transformed physics.
target_text: Na mvula 1905, na mvula 26, Einstein me sonika mikanda yiya me kunata nsobolo ya nene na fiziki.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These include his special relativity theory, which introduced the concepts of space and time as a single unified continuum, and his general relativity theory, which proposed that gravity is not a force, but is instead a curvature of spacetime.
target_text: Yawu me kangama sungula na malongi ya relativite, yina ke na kulakisa mutindu ya kutadila kisika mpe ntangu muntindu bima kena kusala kintwadi, mpe malongi ya yandi ya relativite, yina ke na kuzonza ti gravite kele ngolo ve kansi kima ke landa kisika mpe ntangu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Einstein's work led to a new understanding of the universe, and had a profound impact on the development of modern physics.
target_text: Kisalu ya Einstein pesaka mutindu ya kubakula ya malumalu ya yinza, mpe me kusoba nzangululu ya fiziki ya malumalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921 for his explanation of the photoelectric effect.
target_text: Yandi yambaka Dikabu ya Nene na Fiziki na 1921 samu na mbangululu ya yandi ya kisalu ya photoelectrique.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Einstein was a pacifist and a strong advocate for social justice.
target_text: Einstein vwandaka muntu zolaka ngemba mpe nzonzi ya nene ya lunungu.

source_text: Many people wake up before sunrise to start their day's work.

source_text: People who work in the city may also wake up early to catch the bus or train to work.

source_text: Once people are up, they typically eat a simple breakfast of porridge, bread, or tea.

source_text: Many people in The Gambia wear traditional clothing, such as long dresses or skirts for women and long pants or shirts for men.

source_text: They may also wear a headscarf or cap.
target_text: Balenda mpe kulwata kitambala to mpu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: After breakfast, people go about their daily activities.
target_text: Na manima ya kudya na suka, bantu ke kwena na bisalu ya bawu ya kilumbu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Children go to school, while adults go to work.
target_text: Bana ke kwenda na lukolo, na bambuta ke kwenda na kisalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Many people in The Gambia work in agriculture, fishing, or tourism.
target_text: Bantu mingi na Gambi ke salaka bilanga, kelobaka mbisi, to kesalaka nzietolo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Others work in government, business, or education.
target_text: Ba yankaka ke salaka na luyalu, salaka ba nkadi ya nene, to kulonguka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In the afternoon, people may take a break from work to relax or socialize.
target_text: Na manima ya midi, bantu ke pema na kisalu na kupemisa nzutu to kusosa kuvwanda mbote na bantu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They may go for a walk, visit friends and family, or play games.
target_text: Ba lenda kwenda na kisalu, kutadisa bampangi mpe dikanda, to kubula bansaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In the evening, people often eat dinner with their families.
target_text: Na mpimpa, bantu kedyaka mingi na makanda ya bawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Dinner is typically a simple meal of rice, vegetables, and meat or fish.
target_text: Kudya ya mpimpa ke vwandaka mingi ya mpamba mutindu loso, bandunda, mpe ngombe to mbisi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The gadgets and utensils of the kitchen are a language, a means of communication between cook and food.
target_text: Bima mpe bisadulu ya kikuku kele ndinga, nzila ya disolo kati na kulamba mpe madya.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The whisk, the tongs, the ladle, the spatula - each has its own meaning, its own purpose.
target_text: Fouet, bibwetolo, balutu, lutu ya dibaya - konso kima ke na mbangula ya yawu, mfunu ya yawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: To use them well is to understand the language of cooking, to season the dish with the flavors of experience and skill.
target_text: Na kusadila yawu mbote nge fwana kuzaba ndinga ya kulamba, kulamba madya na bambuma ya kitoko na mayele mpe mutindu na mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The whisk is a whisk, the tongs are tongs, and the ladle is a ladle.
target_text: Fouet kele fouet, bibwetolo kele bibwetolo, mpe lutu kele lutu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: But in the hands of a skilled cook, they become something more: they become extensions of the cook's own body, tools that allow him or her to express creativity and passion.
target_text: Kansi maboko ya kilambi me zaba kisalu, ke kumaka kima mutindu yinda ya nzutu ya kilambi yandi mosi, bisadulu yina ke pesa yandi nzila na kusala bima ya malumalu mpe yina yandi me zola mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: With a whisk, the cook can whip up a frothy batter or emulsify a delicate sauce.
target_text: Na fouet, kilambi lenda kubalula pate to kuyidika sosi ya mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: With tongs, he or she can flip a steak or turn a roast.
target_text: Na bibbwetolo, bakala to kento lenda sadisa na kubalula musini ya ngombe to kubalula kima ba me lamba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: With a ladle, he or she can ladle out a steaming bowl of soup or sauce.
target_text: Kibwetolo, yandi (bakala) to yandi (kento) lenda kudyamisa kibwetolo na nzungu ya supu to ya sosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The gadgets and utensils of the kitchen are more than just tools.
target_text: Bima mpe bisadulu ya kikuku me kuluta bisadulu ya mpamba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They are a means of expression, a way to create something beautiful and delicious.
target_text: Ya ke munti ya kuzonza, nzila ya kuyidika kima ya mbote mpe ya kilengi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A seed is a small, dormant plant embryo that is capable of developing into a new plant under the right conditions.
target_text: Mbuma ya fyoti, mbuma ya kukunda lenda kukula na yiti ya malumalu yina ba lenda kunda na mutindu ya mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When a seed sprouts, it begins to grow roots and shoots.
target_text: Ntangu mbuma ke na kukula, ya ke banda kukudisa mianzi mpe bifulu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The roots anchor the plant in the soil and absorb water and nutrients from the ground.
target_text: Mianzi ke simbaka yiti na ntoto mpe ke nwaka masa mingi mpe madya na ntoto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The shoots grow upwards towards the sun, and the leaves begin to photosynthesize, producing food for the plant.
target_text: Bifulu kekulaka na ntwala ya ntangu, mpe makasa ke basikaka na photosynthese, na kubasisaka madya ke kudya yinti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: As the plant grows, it develops a stem, leaves, flowers, and fruit.
target_text: Yina yinti ke na kukula, ya ke kudisa yinti, makasa, bifulu, mpe mbuma.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The flowers produce seeds, which are dispersed by wind, water, or animals.
target_text: Bifulu ke pesa bambuma ya kukunda, yina ke mangana na kitembo, masa, to bibulu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When a seed lands in a suitable location, it can germinate and begin the process of growth all over again.
target_text: Ntangu mbuma ya kukunda ke kunwa na kisika ya kitoko, ya ke basika mpe ke banda kukula dyaka mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The process of seed germination is a marvel of nature.
target_text: Nsadulu ya kukula ya mbuma kele kima ya kitoko ya ntoto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is a testament to the power of life and the resilience of the natural world.
target_text: Ya kele luwawanu ya lulendo ya luzingu mpe kuvutuka manima ya ntoto ya mvimba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When a seed sprouts, it is a sign of hope and new beginnings.
target_text: Ntangu mbuma ke basika, ya ke pesa kidimbu ya kivuvu mpe kubanda dyaka ya mambu ya malumalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You have been warned.
target_text: Ba lwengisaka nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You have been given a clear and concise warning.
target_text: Ndwengoso ya kedika mpe ya kusema pesamaka na nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You have been told that if you continue to engage in this behavior, you will be banned.
target_text: Ba tubilika nge ti kana nge tatamana kuvanda na mbelo yayi, ba ke manga nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You have now had two chances to correct your behavior, and you have failed to do so.
target_text: Ba mabaku zole me kupesama na nge na kudedikisa mbelo ya nge, mpe nge me kubwa na kusala yawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: As a result, you will now be banned from this forum.
target_text: Mutindu mvutu ya kisalu, ba ke manga nge na kinkuku ya kinzonzi yayi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This ban is permanent, and you will not be allowed to create a new account or participate in this forum in any way.
target_text: Kumanga yayi ke vwanda ya ntangu nyonso, mpe nge ke kupesame nzila ve na kufungula konti ya malumalu to kubaka kisika na kikunku ya kinzozi yayi ata fyoti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We hope that this ban will serve as a warning to others who may be tempted to engage in similar behavior.
target_text: Beto me sala kivuvu ti kumanga yayi ke vwanda mutindu nduengoso na ba yankaka yina ke sosa kuvwanda na bambelo ya mutindu yayi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We will not tolerate this type of behavior on our forum, and we will take action to protect our community from it.
target_text: Beto ke kundima ve mutindu ya mbelo yayi na kikunku ya kizonzi yayi, mpe beto ke sala nyonso samu na kukeba bantu ya beto na yawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If you have any questions about this ban, please do not hesitate to contact us.
target_text: Kana nge kele na byuvu na yina me tala kumanga, kubadisa ntima ve na kukutana na beto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Thank you for your cooperation.
target_text: Matondo samu na nsalasani ya nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "What the hell are you doing, you idiot?!"
target_text: "Yinki nge ke na kusala, nge ke zoba?!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Excuse me?"
target_text: "Lemvokila munu?"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "You cut me off! You almost made me crash!"
target_text: "Nge me zenga munu kinzozi! Nge me kufwa munu ya mvimba!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "I'm sorry, I didn't mean to. I was just trying to get around that slow-moving truck."
target_text: "Mu lemvo, mu zola zonza mutindu yina ve. Mu vwandaka kaka kumeka kuzwa ditoma yayi ke na kukwenda malembe."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Well, you could have at least used your turn signal!"
target_text: "Ya ke mbote, nge lenda ata kusadila mwinda ya ditoma ya nge!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "I did use my turn signal!"
target_text: "Mu fwana kusadila mwinda ya ditoma ya nge!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "No, you didn't! You just pulled right out in front of me!"
target_text: "Ve, nge salaka yawu ve! Nge sala yawu kaka na ntwala ya munu!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "I'm telling you, I used my turn signal!"
target_text: "Mu ke na kutubila nge, Mu sadilaka mwinda ya ditoma ya munu!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Whatever. You're still a terrible driver."
target_text: "Mambu ve. Nge ke kaka kinati ditoma ya yimbi."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "And you're a jerk!"
target_text: "Mpe nge ke zoba!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "At least I know how to drive!"
target_text: "Ya mfunu Mu me zaba kunata!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Oh, yeah? Well, I'm a better writer than you are!"
target_text: "O, ya kedika? Ni mutindu yina, Mu ke kisoniki ya mbote kulutila nge!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "That's debatable."
target_text: "Ya lenda kusosa beto kusobasana mabanza na yawu."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "It's not debatable! I'm Ernest Hemingway!"
target_text: "Beto lenda ve kusobasana mabanza na yawu! Mu ke Ernest Hemingway!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Who?"
target_text: "Nani?"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Ernest Hemingway! The greatest writer of all time!"
target_text: "Ernest Hemingway! Kisoni ya nene ya ntangu nyonso!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Never heard of him."
target_text: "Nabunu mu kuwa nkumbu ya yandi na muntu."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Well, you've heard of me now!"
target_text: "Ni yawu, nge me kuwa nkumbu ya munu malumalu yayi!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Yeah, I heard of you."
target_text: "Ee, Mu me kuwa nkumbu ya nge."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grace: Can you tell me a little bit about its history?
target_text: Grace: Nge lenda tubila munu mwa fyoti lisolo na yandi?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Teacher: Of course. Tea originated in China, where it has been cultivated for over 5,000 years.
target_text: Kilongisi: Ya tsieleka. The me katuka na Chine, kisi bakundaka yawu kuluta bamvula 5000.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The first written record of tea dates back to the 3rd century BC, when it was mentioned in a Chinese medical text.
target_text: Bisono ya ntete ya the salamaka na mvu-nkama ya tatu (3) Tekila Yesu Butuka (BC), ntangu basonikaka yawu na bisono ya manganga ya bana ya Chine.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Tea was originally used as a medicinal herb, but it quickly became a popular drink among Chinese people of all social classes.
target_text: Ba vwandaka sadila the samu na manganga ya bayinti, kansi ya kumaka malafu ya bantu nyonso kati ya bantu ya Chine ya bamputu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grace: What about outside of China? When did tea start to spread to other parts of the world?
target_text: Grace: Yinki beto lenda zonza na nganda ya Chine? Wapi ntangu the bandaka kumwangana na yinza ya muvimba?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Teacher: Tea was first introduced to Europe in the 16th century by Portuguese traders.
target_text: Kilongisi: The kotaka mbala ya ntete na Mputu na mvu-nkama ya 16 na biteki ya bana ya Portugal.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It quickly became popular among European elites, and by the 18th century, tea had become a staple of British culture.
target_text: Ya kumaka na mbangu kima ya kuzabana na bandwenga nyonso ya Mputu mpe na mvu-nkama ya 18, the me kuma kidimbu ya kinkulu ya bana ya Angleterre.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In the 19th century, tea was also introduced to North America, where it became a popular drink among both colonists and Native Americans.
target_text: Na yimvu-nkama ya 19, the kotaka mpe na Amerika ya Londe, kisika ya kumaka malafu ya kuzabakana kati na bantu ya nene mpe Bana ya Amerika.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grace: That's really interesting.I never knew that tea had such a long history.
target_text: Grace: Ya ke mbote mingi. Mu zabaka ve ti the vwanda na mutindu disolo yayi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Teacher: It's a fascinating story, and it's one that's still being written today.
target_text: Kilongisi: Ya ke diloso ya kitoko mingi, mpe ya ke mosi yina bafwana kusoni na mikanda bubu yayi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: During World War II, the Allies and Axis powers used a variety of aircraft to achieve air superiority.
target_text: Na ntangu ya Mvita na nene ya Ntonto ya mvimba ya zole (II), Kimvuka ya binwani ya Alliés mpe ya Axe sadilaka mipepe ya zulu samu na kulakisa bunene ya mipepe ya bawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One of the most important factors in determining the outcome of a battle was the accuracy of the aircraft's bombing.
target_text: Mosi ya mambu ke mfunu mingi na kuzabi nzila ya kunatina muzingu vwandaka ludedomo ya babombe yina mupepe vwandaka kukubula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The height at which an aircraft could fly was also a critical factor, as it determined how far it could travel and how much weight it could carry.
target_text: Mutindu mupepe ke pumbwa na zulu mingi vwandaka dyambu ya mfunu, samu ya vwandaka kulakisa wapi mutindu yawau lendaka tatuka ntama na zulu mpe mutindu ya kilo yawu lendaka nata.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The United States developed a number of high-altitude bombers during the war, including the B-17 Flying Fortress and the B-29 Superfortress.
target_text: Etazini yidikaka babombe mingi ya kukubula na zulu ntangu ya mvita, kubakisa B-17 Kimvama ke tambula na zulu mpe B-29 Kimwama mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These aircraft were able to fly at altitudes of over 30,000 feet, which made them difficult for enemy fighters to intercept.
target_text: Ba avio yayi vwandaka na ngolo ya kutambula na zulu mingi na yinda 30.000, yina vwandaka pesa mpasi na binwani ya mbeni na ku kanga yawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They also carried a large payload of bombs, which could be used to attack targets deep behind enemy lines.
target_text: Yawi vwandaka kunata babombe ya mfunu mingi, yina ba lenda sadima na kunwanisa mbeni yina ke na mfinda ya ndilu ya mvita.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The German Luftwaffe also developed a number of high-altitude bombers, including the Heinkel He 177 Greif and the Messerschmitt Me 264 Amerika Bomber.
target_text: Luftwaffe ya Zamani yidikaka babombe ke bulaka na zulu mingi, kubwela Heinkel He 177 Greif mpe Messerschmitt Me 264 Amerika Bomber.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These aircraft were not as successful as their American counterparts, however, due to a number of technical problems.
target_text: Ba avio nunga mbote ve mutindu ya bampangi na bawu ya Amerika, atako, ya salamaka samu na ba mpasi ya tekiniki yina talanaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I know what you did yesterday.
target_text: Mu me zaba wapi mambu nge salaka mazono.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You posted a picture of yourself wearing that green rag on social media.
target_text: Nge tulaka foto ya nge mosi nge vwataka kitenda ya ngizu na basite ya kutindila bansangu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I know you thought it was funny, but it wasn’t.
target_text: Mu me zaba ti nge banzaka ti ya vwandaka mbote, kansi ya vwandaka ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It was disrespectful to your mother, and it hurt her feelings.
target_text: Ya vwandaka buzitu ve na mama ya nge, mpe ya lwadisaka mabanza ya yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I’m not asking you to apologize because I’m mad at you.
target_text: Mu ke na kulomba na nge ve mulemvo samu kilawu na ntwala ya nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I’m asking you to apologize because it’s the right thing to do.
target_text: Mu ke na kulomba na nge na kulomba mulemvo ya ke kima ya mbote na kusala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Your mother loves you, and she deserves your respect.
target_text: Mama ya nge me zola nge, mpe nge fwana kupesa yandi buzitu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Please call her today and tell her you’re sorry.
target_text: Mulemvo bokila yandi bubu yayi mpe zabisa yandi ti nge ke na kiadi na yina me luta.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Tell her that you didn’t mean to hurt her feelings, and that you promise to never wear that green rag again.
target_text: Zonza na yandi ti nge zola zonza ve kulwadisa mabanza ya yandi, mpe nge me pesa nsilulu ya kuvwata dyaka ve kilele ya ngizu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I know you’re a good person, and I know you love your mother.
target_text: Mu me zaba ti nge ke muntu ya mbote, mpe mu zaba nge me zola mama ya nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: So please, do the right thing and apologize.
target_text: Na yina mulemvo ya nge, sala mambu ya kudelakana mpe lemvokila.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: After you apologize to your mother, I want you to burn that green rag.
target_text: Na manima ya kulomba nlemvo na mama ya nge, Mu zola nye yoka lele yina ya ngizu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It’s a symbol of your disrespect, and it needs to be gone.
target_text: Ya kele kidimbu ya kukondwa buzitu na nge, mpe ya fwana kukatuka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I know it might be hard to let go of that rag, but it’s important.
target_text: Mu zaba ya lenda vwanda mpasi na kubika kilele yina, kansi ya kele mfunu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It’s a symbol of your past, and it’s time to move on.
target_text: Ya kele kidimbu ya kizingu ya nge ya mazono, kansi ntangu me lunga na kukwenda na ntwala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You’re a new person now.
target_text: Nge ke muntu ya malumalu na ntangu yayi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You’re a better person.
target_text: Nge ke muntu ya mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: And you don’t need that rag to define you anymore.
target_text: Mpe nge ke na satu ya kilele yina ata fyoti ve na ku vwanda muntu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: So please, burn it.
target_text: Mulemvo, yoka yawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Burn it and let it go.
target_text: Yoka yawu mpe bika ya kuenda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: And then go hug your mother and tell her you love her.
target_text: Mpe na yina kwenda kuyamba mama ya nge na maboko mpe tuba na yandi ti nge me zola yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She loves you too.
target_text: Yandi me zola nge mpe mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A car was driving too fast and lost control, swerving into the other lane and hitting a car head-on.
target_text: Ditoma vwandaka tambula mbangu mingi mpe zimbisaka lukebolo, kutatuka mwa fyoti na ndilu ya nzila mpe tutaka ntwala ya ditoma.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The driver of the first car was killed instantly, and the driver of the second car was seriously injured.
target_text: Kinati ya ditoma ya ntete fwaka mbala mosi, mpe kinati ya ditoma ya zole lwalaka bamputa ya ngolo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Here is a delicious pork dish from the county of Lancashire.

source_text: Ingredients: 1kg pork belly, 1 tbsp English mustard, 1 tbsp black treacle, 1 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 large onion, 4 cloves garlic, 2 bay leaves, 1 sprig of thyme, 100ml cider, 100ml chicken stock, 1 tbsp cornflour, 2 tbsp cold water.

source_text: 1. Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.

source_text: 2. Trim the pork belly of any excess fat and score the skin in a criss-cross pattern.

notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: 3. In a bowl, mix together the mustard, treacle, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and oil.

notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Rub this mixture all over the pork belly.

notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: 4. Place the pork belly in a roasting tin and roast in the oven for 2 hours, or until the skin is golden brown and the meat is cooked through.

source_text: 5. While the pork is roasting, finely chop the onion, garlic, bay leaves and thyme.

source_text: Freshwater lakes are home to a wide variety of flora and fauna, from microscopic algae to large fish and mammals.

source_text: These organisms are the primary producers in the lake ecosystem, and they are the basis of the food chain.

target_text: Na manima, yandi bandaka kulongisa beto matematiki.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I was a little bit confused at first, but Ms. Smith explained everything clearly.
target_text: Na ntete mu zabaka dyaka ve mambu ya kusala, kansi Mama Smith bangudilaka beto mambu nyonso pwelele.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: After math class, we had a break.
target_text: Na manima ya kulonguka matematiki, beto pemaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Sarah and I went outside to play on the playground.
target_text: Sarah na munu beto basikaka na kwenda kusakana na nganda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We played on the swings and the slide for a while, then we went back inside for lunch.
target_text: Beto sakana na kuzungana mpe kusielomuka mwa fyoti, na manima beto me vutuka samu na kudya.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When tissue is injured, the body’s immune system sends white blood cells to the area.
target_text: Kana mukanda ya nzutu me lwala, systeme immunitaire ya nzutu ke fidisa menga ya ba cellule ya mpembe na kizunga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These cells release chemicals that cause blood vessels to dilate and become more permeable.
target_text: Ba cellule ke basisaka ba bima ya kimunganga ke ku nata kusala ya misisa ya menga mpe kukuma pete mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This allows fluid and white blood cells to leak out of the blood vessels and into the injured tissue.
target_text: Ya ke pesa nzila na masa mpe menga ya pembe na kupasika na misisa ya menga mpe na mukanda me lwala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The fluid forms a clear, watery swelling called edema.
target_text: Masa ke yidikaka mvimbu ke talana ya pwelele na nkumbu ya edema.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The white blood cells help to fight infection and to remove damaged tissue.
target_text: Menga ya pembe kesadisaka na kunwanisa ba infection mpe ke manisaka mukanda ya kubeba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They also release chemicals that stimulate the growth of new tissue.
target_text: Ya ke manisaka kimungaka ke pesaka mvingu na kukula ya mukanda ya nzutu ya malumalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The classic signs of acute inflammation are redness, heat, swelling, and pain.
target_text: Bidimbu me zabana ya kuvimba ya nzutu kele mbwaki, tiya, mvimbu, mpe mpasi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These signs are caused by the increased blood flow and the release of chemicals in the injured tissue.
target_text: Bidimbu yayi ke katukaka na kubasika ya menga mingi mpe kukatula ya bima ya kimunganga na mukanda me lwala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Redness is caused by the dilation of blood vessels.
target_text: Mbwaki me katuka na kudyama ya misisa ya menga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Heat is caused by the increased blood flow and the release of inflammatory chemicals.
target_text: Tiya me katuka na kubasika mingi ya menga mpe kumanisa ya bima ya kimungana me vimbisa nzutu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Swelling is caused by the leakage of fluid from blood vessels into the injured tissue.
target_text: Mvimbu me katuka na kubasika na masa na misisa ya memba na kati ya mukanda na nzutu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Pain is caused by the release of inflammatory chemicals and the pressure of the swelling.
target_text: Mpasi me katuka kubasika ya ba bima ya kimunganga mpe kubasika ya menga na ngolo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Acute inflammation is a normal part of the healing process.
target_text: Mvimbu ya nene ke dyambu ke kumaka na ntangu ya ngwasulu ya mputa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: However, if it is severe or prolonged, it can damage healthy tissue.
target_text: Na yina, ya ke tadisa mpasi to kuzinga mingi, ya lenda kubebisa mukanza ya nzutu ke na mavimpi ya mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In some cases, acute inflammation can lead to chronic inflammation, which is a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability, and even death.
target_text: Ba ntangu ya nkaka, mvimbu ya nene lenda kunata mvimbu ke manisaka ve, yawu lenda tadisa mpasi ntangu ya yinda, kufwa ya binama, mpe lufwa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are a number of things that can cause acute inflammation, including infection, injury, and autoimmune diseases.
target_text: Mambu mingi lenda kusala ti mvimbu ya nene, kubwela infection, mputa mpe bimbefo ke manisaka ngolo ya nzutu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Infections are caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi.
target_text: Infection ke katukaka na mwa ba nyama ya fyoti, na virisi, to kimbefo ya mfinda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When these organisms enter the body, they can trigger an immune response that leads to inflammation.
target_text: Ntangu mwa banyama yayi ke kota na nzutu, ya ke banda mvutu ya nzutu yina ke nata mvimbu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Injuries can also cause inflammation.
target_text: Bamputa mpe lenda kunata mvimbu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When tissue is damaged, it releases chemicals that attract white blood cells and other immune cells to the area.
target_text: Ntangu nzutu ke beba, ya ke manisa kimunganga yina ke kuzwa ba cellule ya menga mpe ba cellule ya kupesa nzutu ngolo na kizuga yina.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These cells release chemicals that cause inflammation.
target_text: Ba cellule yina ke manisaka kimunganga me katuka na mvimbu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Autoimmune diseases are caused by the body’s immune system attacking its own tissues.
target_text: Bimbefo yina ke katukaka na nzutu ke katukaka na systeme ya lukengolo ya nzutu ke nwanisaka mikanda ya nzutu yawu mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This can lead to inflammation in the affected tissues.
target_text: Ya lenda kunata mvimbu na mikanda ya nzutu yina kena kubela.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Acute inflammation is usually treated with pain relievers, such as ibuprofen or acetaminophen.
target_text: Ba ke bukaka mvimbu ya nene mingi na manganga ya kumanisa mpasi, mutindu ibuprofne to acetaminophene.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In some cases, corticosteroids may be used to reduce inflammation.
target_text: Bantangu ya nkaka, ba lenda kusadila corticosteroide na kukulula mvimbu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If the inflammation is caused by an infection, antibiotics may be prescribed.
target_text: Kana mvimbu me katuka na infection, ba lenda kusonika ba antibiotiki.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Chronic inflammation is a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability, and even death.
target_text: Mvimbu ke manisaka mbangu ve kele mvwandulu ya ntangu yinda yina lenda tadisa mpasi, kubebisa binama, mpe kunata na lufwa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is often caused by autoimmune diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis and Crohn’s disease.
target_text: Ya ke katukaka mingi na bimbefo nzutu ke pesaka, mutindu polyartrite rhumatoide mpe kimbefo ya Crohn.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Chronic inflammation can also be caused by obesity, smoking, and air pollution.
target_text: Mvimbu yina ke bekukaka na mbangu ve lenda katuka na kuvwanda na nzutu nene kulutila, nwuinu ya fumu, mpe mupepe ya yimbi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There is no cure for chronic inflammation, but it can be managed with medication, lifestyle changes, and physical therapy.
target_text: Ya ke ve na manganga samu na mvimvu ke belukaka ve kansi ba lenda kulembika yawu na manganga, nsobolo ya mutindu ya kuvwanda na luzingu, mpe kubeluka ya nzutu na bangalasisi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The Mozambican Civil War was a conflict that lasted from 1977 to 1992.
target_text: Mvita kati na Yinsi ya Mozambique vwandaka na mavwanga yina zingaka banda yimvu 1977 tii na 1992.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It was fought between the Mozambique Liberation Front (FRELIMO), which had ruled the country since its independence from Portugal in 1975, and the Mozambique National Resistance (RENAMO), a rebel group backed by the Rhodesian and South African governments.
target_text: Ya wwandaka muzingu kati na Front ua Liberation ya Mozambique (FRELIMO), yina yalaka yinsi banda dipanda na maboko ya Portugal na 1975, mpe Resistance Nationale ya Mozambique (RENAMO), kimvuka ya bantu ya mavwanga na lutumu ya bantu ya Rhodesie mpe baluyalu ya Afidika ya Banda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The war caused widespread devastation and displacement, and led to the deaths of an estimated 1 million people.
target_text: Mvita ke bebisaka bima mingi mpe kutambula ya bantu, mpe ke nataka lufwa ya kitezo ya bantu milio 1 ya bantu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The war began after RENAMO launched an insurgency against FRELIMO in 1977.
target_text: Mvita bandaka na manima yina RENAMO bandaka mavwanga na FRELIMO na 1977.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: RENAMO was opposed to FRELIMO's socialist policies and its close ties to the Soviet Union.
target_text: RENAMO zolaka ve politiki ya socialiste ya FRELIMO mpe kinkundi ya yandi na Union Soviétique.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The war quickly escalated, and by the early 1980s, RENAMO had control of much of the countryside.
target_text: Mvita zwaka kitezo ya nene, mpe mbadukulu ya yimvu 1980, RENAMO vwandaka kuyala kizunga ya nene ya yinsi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: FRELIMO was forced to rely on Soviet and Cuban military aid to keep RENAMO at bay.
target_text: FRELIMO bindamaka na kutula kaka kivuvu na yandi na lusadusu ya basoda ya Union Soviétique mpe ya Cuba samu na kubingisa RENAMO.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In 1984, FRELIMO and RENAMO signed a peace agreement, but the fighting continued.
target_text: Na 1984, FRELIMO mpe RENAMO tulaka maboko na mukanda ya ngwisani samu na ngemba, kansi mvita vwandaka kaka kutatamana.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In 1992, the two sides signed a new peace agreement, which called for a ceasefire and the holding of multiparty elections.
target_text: Na 1992, bikunku zole yayi me kutula dyaka maboko na mukanda ya ngwisani ya ngemba ya malumalu, yina ba me bokila kumanisa kubula minduki mpe kusalama ya bansololo ya bapalati nyonso.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It was a bright and sunny day in the small village of Locksmiths, and the festival of locks was in full swing.
target_text: Ya vwandaka kilumbu ya kulezima mpe ya kukia na mbanza ya fyoti ya Locksmiths, mpe bamyelo ya feti vwandaka na mukembo ya nene.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The streets were crowded with people, all eager to see the latest and greatest in lockmaking technology.
target_text: Banzila fulukaka na bantu, bawu nyonso nsatu ya kutala tekiniki ya kuyidika bafungula ya nsuka mpe ya mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There were vendors selling everything from simple padlocks to complex combination locks, and artisans demonstrating their skills in lockpicking and locksmithing.
target_text: Ya vwandaka na biteki vwandaka kutekisa bima nyonso banda ba bisengo ya kukangila ya pamba tii bafungula ya ngolo ba me vukisa, mpe bisadi ya bisalu ya maboko lakisaka mayele ya bawu na kukanga na bacroshe mpe na fungula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In the center of the village square, a large stage had been set up for the day's festivities.
target_text: Na kaikati ya bwala, kifulu ya nene ya bansaka tulwaka samu na mukembo ya kilumbu ya bafeti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A group of musicians were playing lively tunes, and a crowd of people were gathered around, clapping and dancing.
target_text: Kimvuka ya miyimbidi vwandaka kuyimba miziki ya kubinisa bantu, mpe bantu mingi kutakanaka kuna, vwandaka kubula maboko mpe kubina.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: On the stage, a skilled locksmith was demonstrating how to pick a lock, and the crowd was mesmerized by his skill.
target_text: Na kifulu ya nsaka, kityidiki ya kroshe ya mayela vwandaka kulakisa mutindu ya kutula kroshe na fungula, mpe ndonga ya bantu kangamaka na mayele ya yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: As the sun began to set, the festival came to a close.
target_text: Yina ntangu bandaka kukwenda na kumanisa, feti kangaka mielo ya yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: My friend, Abel, and I were walking home from school one day when we saw a blood drive being held at our local community center.
target_text: Nkundi ya munu, Abel, mpe kilumbu mosi mu katukaka na lukolo na vwandaka kukwenda na yinzo ntangu mu me talaka ba vwandaka kuzwa menga ya bantu na kifulu ke kutakanaka bantu ya bwala ya beto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We were both 17 years old, and we had never donated blood before.
target_text: Beto zole vwandaka na bamvula 17, mpe nabunu beto vwandaka me pesa menga ntete.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We decided to stop in and see what it was all about.
target_text: Beto zwaka lukanu ya kukangama mpe kutala yinki vwandaka luta.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The process of donating blood was actually pretty simple.
target_text: Dyambu ya kupesa menga vwandaka kaka dyambu ya mpasi ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We both filled out a questionnaire and answered some questions about our health history.
target_text: Beto fulusaka lisite ya byuvu mpe vutulaka bamvutu na mwa byuvu na yina me tala disolo ya mavimpi ya beto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Then, we had our blood pressure checked and our veins were checked to make sure they were big enough.
target_text: Na manima, ba me fimba tansio ya menga ya beto mpe misisa ya beto fimpwaka samu na kukwikila kana ya vwanda mwa nene.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Once we were cleared to donate, we each sat down in a chair and had a needle inserted into our arms.
target_text: Yina beto vwandaka ya kukubama na kupesa menga, beto vwandaka na kiti mpe be tobulaka beto tumbu na maboko ya beto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The blood was collected in a bag, and the whole process took about 15 minutes.
target_text: Batulaka menga ba bakaka na mwa saki, mpe nyonso bakaka baminiti 15.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It felt good to know that we were helping to save lives.
target_text: Ya vwandaka dyambu ya mbote na kuzaba ti beto vwandaka kuvukisa bizingu ya bantu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: After we donated, we were given a juice box and a cookie to help us recover.
target_text: Na manima ya kupesa menga, ba pesaka beto dilanta ya jus mpe bisiki samu na kuzwa mawa ngolo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We also received a thank-you card from the blood bank.
target_text: Beto yambaka mpe kalati ya mvutudulu matondo na maboko ya banki ya menga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I'm glad that Abel and I decided to donate blood.
target_text: Mu yangalalaka na yina ti Abel na Munu zwaka lukanu ya kupesa menga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It was a quick and easy way to make a difference in the world.
target_text: Ya vwandaka nzila ya mbangu mpe ya pete na kusala diswaswani na yinza ya muvimba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I encourage everyone to consider donating blood if they are eligible.
target_text: Mu ke na kulomba na konso muntu na kuzola kupesa menga kana ba me kusolwa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It's a simple act of kindness that can help save lives.
target_text: Ya ke mutindu ya kulakisa nsayi ya mpamba yina lenda sadisa na kuvukisa bizingu ya bantu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A solo traveler was found safe after spending two nights lost in the Swiss Alps.
target_text: Kizieti yina vwandaka yandi mosi talanaka na mavimpi ya mbote na manima ya kulutisa bampimpa zole yina yandi zimbanaka kati na Bamongo ya Swisse.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The 25-year-old woman, who has not been identified, was hiking in the mountains when she became separated from her group.
target_text: Kento ya bamvula 25, yina ba zabaka ve, vwandaka tambula na bamongo ntangu yandi tatukaka ntama na kikunku ya bantu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She was reported missing on Tuesday, and search teams were dispatched to find her.
target_text: Ba pesaka bansangu ya kuzimbana ya yandi na kilumbu ya zole, mpe ba ekipe ya bisosi mwanganaka samu na kusosa yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The woman was eventually found on Thursday, about 10 miles from where she had been hiking.
target_text: Ba talaka kento yina na kilumbu ya Yiya, na yinda ya bametele 10 ya kisika yina yandi vwandaka kwenda tambula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She was cold and dehydrated, but otherwise in good condition.
target_text: Nzutu na yandi vwandaka madidi mpe kondwaka masa, kansi yandi vwandaka mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She told rescuers that she had been following a trail when she got turned around.
target_text: Yandi tubaka na bivukisi na yandi vwandaka kwenda landaka kaka mwa nzila ya fyoti ntangu yandi vutukaka manima.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She spent the night in a cave, and she survived by eating snow and drinking from a stream.
target_text: Yandi lutisaka mpimpa ya dibulu ya ditadi, mpe na kuvwanda moyo yandi vwandaka kuya neze mpe kunwa masa vwandaka luta ngolo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The woman's experience is a reminder of the importance of being prepared when hiking in the mountains.
target_text: Mambu kuminaka na kento ke na kubambula moyo na mfunu ya kukubamaka na ntangu ya kutambula na bamongo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Hikers should always bring a map, compass, and a flashlight, and they should tell someone where they are going and when they expect to return.
target_text: Bitambudi fwana kuvwanda na mukanda ya bisika ya kizunga, busole, mpe mwinda ya fyoti, mpe ba fwana zabisa muntu kisika bawu ke na kukwenda mpe wapi ntangu ba ke kuvutuka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When I was a kid, I would spend hours poring over magazines.
target_text: Ntangu mu vwandaka mwana fyoti, mu vwandaka lutisa ntangu na kubebisa ba zulunalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I would read every article, look at every picture, and cut out the ones I liked to put in my scrapbook.
target_text: Mu zolaka kutanga disolo nyonso, kutalaka bifwanisu, mpe kuzenga yina mu vwanda zola mpe kutula yawu na album ya munu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I loved the way magazines could transport me to different worlds and make me think about things in new ways.
target_text: Mu zolaka mutindu bazulunalu vwandaka nata munu na kitezo kutala yinza ya diswaswani mpe vwandaka sala mu yindula mambu na mitindu ya nkaka ya malumalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One day, I was reading an article about brain science in a magazine.
target_text: Kilumbu mosi, mu vwandaka tanga disolo na yina me tala luzabu ya butomfu ya yitu na zulunalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The article was really interesting, and it made me think about how my brain works.
target_text: Disolo yango vwandaka kitoko mingi, mpe ya nataka munu na kuyindula na mutindu butomfu ya yitu ke tambulaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I realized that I could use my brain to learn anything I wanted, and that was an amazing feeling.
target_text: Mu bakulaka ti mu lenda kusadila butomfu ya yitu na kulonguka kima nyonso mu zola, mpe ya vwandaka kima ya mbote na kuzaba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I've been reading magazines ever since, and I still love the way they can open my mind to new ideas.
target_text: Mu vwandaka tanga bazulunalo katuka ntama, mpe ntangu nyonso muke zolaka mutindu ya lenda fungula mayele ya munu na mabanza ya malumalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The debate about whether animals are happier in the wild or in zoos is a complex one with no easy answers.
target_text: Masolo na yina me tala kana bibulu ke ya kuyangalala na mfinda to na mpaka ya bibumu kele dyambu ya mpasi yina bamvutu ya yawu ke ya pete ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are many factors to consider, including the individual animal's needs, the type of zoo, and the quality of care provided.
target_text: Ba fwana kutadila mambu mingi, kubwela bansatu ya kibulu mosi mosi, kifwani ya mpaka ya bibulu, mpe kitezo ya lusadusu ya mbote to ya yimbi ba ke pesaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Some animals, such as elephants, are highly social and need to interact with other elephants in order to thrive.
target_text: Bibulu ya nkaka, mutindu nzawu, me zola bantu mingi mpe fwana kuvwanda na banzawu ya nkaka samu na kukula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In the wild, elephants live in herds of up to 100 individuals.
target_text: Na mfinda, banzawu ke zingaka na kimvuka ya bibulu kuluta lutangu 100.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They spend their days foraging for food, playing, and socializing.
target_text: Ba ke lutisaka ntangu ya bawu na kusosaka madya, kusakana mpe kusosa kuzaba kuvwanda kintwadi na banzawu ya nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In a zoo, elephants may not have the same opportunities to interact with other elephants, which can lead to boredom and frustration.
target_text: Na mpaka ya bibulu, banzawu lenda kuvwanda na bamabaku mosi ve ya kuvukana na banzawu ya nkaka, yina lenda kunata kinsona mpe boma.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Other animals, such as lions, are solitary hunters.
target_text: Bibulu ya nkaka, mutindu bangambulu, kele bisosi mbisi ke vwandaka kaka bawu mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In the wild, lions live in prides of up to 15 individuals.
target_text: Na mfinda, bangambulu ke vwandaka na kimvuka ya kulutila bibulu 15.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: However, each lion within the pride has its own territory and does not interact with other lions very often.
target_text: Na yawu, konso ngambulu kati na kimvuka ke na kizunga ya yandi mpe bantangu mingi yandi ke vukanaka ve na bangambulu ya nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In a zoo, lions may be able to live in larger enclosures with more space to roam, which can provide them with more opportunities to exercise and explore.
target_text: Na mfinda, bangambulu lenda zinga na ba mpaka me kulutila nene yina ke na kisika balenda tambula, yina lenda pesa bawu mabaku mingi ya kusala bangalasisi mpe kusosa kutala bisika ya malumalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The type of zoo also plays a role in the welfare of its animals.
target_text: Mutindu ya mpaka ya bibulu mpe ke sala kisalu samu na mavimpi ya mbote ya bibulu ke zingaka kati na yawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Some zoos are very large and provide their animals with spacious enclosures, while others are smaller and may not have as much space.
target_text: Bampaka ya nkaka kele nene mpe ke kubikilaka bibulu ya bawu kisika ya nene na kutambula, kansi ya nkaka ke fyoti mpe kisika ya kutambula kele mingi ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: As I'm driving down the road, I see a goat giving birth in the median.
target_text: Yina mu ka na kunata na nzila, mu me tala nkombo ke na kubuta na lweka ya nzila.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She's lying on her side and her two front legs are extended in front of her.
target_text: Yandi lalaka na lweka ya yandi mpe nangunaka makulu ya yandi nyonso zole na ntwala ya yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The baby goat is coming out of her right side and it's head is already visible.
target_text: Mwana ya nkombo vwandaka kubasika na lweka ya yandi ya dibakala mpe yintu yandi talanaka yimeni.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The mother goat looks up at me and I can see the fear in her eyes.
target_text: Mama nkombo talaka munu mpe mu talaka boma na bameso ya yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She's probably wondering if I'm going to hurt her or her baby.
target_text: Yansi vwandaka kukiyufula kana mu ke kulwadisa yandi to mwana ya yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I stop the car and get out.
target_text: Mu kangaka ditoma mpe mu basikaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I walk over to the goat and kneel down next to her.
target_text: Mu pusanaka na ntwala ya nkombo mpe fukamaka na sika ya yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I gently stroke her head and tell her that everything is going to be okay.
target_text: Mu simba yitu ya yandi malembe mpe mu tubaka na yandi mambu nyonso ke luta mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The baby goat starts to emerge and I can see that it's a little girl.
target_text: Mwana ya nkombo banda kubasika mpe mu takala ti yandi vwandaka mwana ya fyoti ya kento.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She's crying and her mother licks her clean.
target_text: Yandi vwandaka dila mpe mama ya yandi vwanda kulekita yandi mbote-mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I watch as the mother goat and baby bond and I feel a sense of peace.
target_text: Mu vwandaka kutala mutindu mama nkombo mpe kukangama ya bebe mpe mu talaka mfunu ya ngemba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The city was a vast, sprawling metropolis, full of life and energy.
target_text: Mbanza vwandaka nene, kulaka na mbangu, me fulukaka na kizingu ya mbote mpe ya ngolo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It was a place where anything was possible, and where dreams could come true.
target_text: Ya vwandaka kisika yina nge lenda sala konso kima, mpe kisika ndosi lenda kukuma tsieleka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: But for every person who found success in the city, there were many more who struggled to make ends meet.
target_text: Kansi atako konso muntu lendaka kuvwanda na kizingu ya mbote, mingi mpe vwandaka nwana samu na kumanisa ngonda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These people lived in the slums, in tiny apartments that were often overcrowded and in disrepair.
target_text: Bantu yayi vwandaka zinga na babwala ya kinsukami, na mwa bayinzo yina vwandaka bantu mingi mpe yimbi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They worked long hours for low pay, and they often had to go without basic necessities like food and healthcare.
target_text: Ba ke salaka bantangu mingi samu na difuta ya fyoti, mpe ba ke vwanda mingi ve na bima ya luzingu ya mfunu mutindu madya mpe lusadusu ya nzutu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One such person was a young woman named Amelia.
target_text: Muntu mosi ya mutindu yayi vwandaka kento na nkumbu ya Amelia.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She had come to the city with big dreams, but she quickly found that reality was much different than she had imagined.
target_text: Yandi kwisaka na mbanza na bandosi ya nene, kansi yandi kwizaka kubakula na mbangu tsieleka vwandaka ya diswaswani na yina yandi vwandaka kuyindula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She worked as a waitress in a small diner, and she could barely make enough money to pay her rent.
target_text: Yandi salaka mutindu kikabudi bima na mwa yinzo ya kutekisa madya, mpe yandi vwandaka kuzwa mwa mbongo ya kufuta yinzo na yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She often went to bed hungry, and she was always worried about her future.
target_text: Mbala mingi yandi vwandaka lala nsatu, mpe yandi vwandaka kaka kuyindula na yina me tala kizingu ya yandi ya mbasi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One day, Amelia was walking home from work when she saw a man sitting on a bench.
target_text: Kilumbu mosi, Amelia katukaka na kisalu mpe vwandaka kwenda na yinzo yandi me tala muntu ya bakala me vwanda na kiti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He was homeless, and he was holding a sign that said, "Will work for food." Amelia felt sorry for the man, and she decided to buy him a sandwich.
target_text: Yandi vwandaka na kisika ya kulala ve, yandi simbaka kidimbu yina basonikaka, "Mu ke sala samu na madya". Amelia talaka kyadi ya bakala yina, mpe zwaka lukanu ya kusumbila yandi sandwich mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: As she was talking to the man, she learned that his name was Charlie.
target_text: Yina yandi vwandaka kupusana na ntwala bakala yina, yandi me tanga nkumbu ya yandi Charlie.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Demonetization is the process of removing legal tender from circulation.
target_text: Demonetisation kele kisalu kukatula mbongo na yinsi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In India, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced on November 8, 2016, that all ₹500 and ₹1000 banknotes would cease to be legal tender from midnight.
target_text: Na Inde, Mfumu ya luyalu ya Ntete Narendra Modi zabisaka ti na kilumbu ya 8 Novembre 2016, banda midi ya mpimpa luyalu ke sadila dyaka ve banoti ya banki nyonso ya 500 mpe 1000.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This move was intended to crack down on corruption and counterfeiting, but it also caused significant disruption and hardship for many people.
target_text: Bazolaka kunimina mutindu ya kusadila yayi ya mayuya mpe ya yimbi, kansi ya nataka mpe ningusunu mingi mpe mpasi na bantu mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are several reasons to be skeptical of demonetization.
target_text: Bikuma kele mingi yina ke na kusala ti bantu vwanda na boma ya demonetisation.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: First, it is not clear that it will be effective in reducing corruption.
target_text: Ya ntete, ya ke na kulakisa ve ti ya ke manisa ya tsieleka mayuya.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Corruption is a complex problem that cannot be solved simply by removing cash from circulation.
target_text: Mayuyakele dyambu ya ngolo yina ba lenda kumanisa ve kaka na kukatula mbongo yina ke na kutambula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In fact, there is some evidence that demonetization may actually increase corruption, as it makes it more difficult for people to track and trace their money.
target_text: Na kutala, ya ke na mabu ke na kulakisa ti demonetisation ke kukudisa dyaka mayuya, samu ya ke pesa mpasi na bantu na kulanda mpe kuzaba nsadulu ya mbongo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Second, demonetization is likely to have a negative impact on the poor.
target_text: Ya zole, demonetisation ke nata mambu ya yimbi na muntu ya mputu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.
