source_text: Many poor people in India rely on cash for their daily transactions.
target_text: Bamputu mingi na Inde kesadilaka mbongo na maboko samu na bisalu ya bawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The sudden withdrawal of large-denomination banknotes made it difficult for them to buy food, pay their bills, and access other essential services.
target_text: Kukatula ya mbangu ya mbongo ya banoti ya banki ke kunatina bawu mpasi na kusumba madya, kufuta bafaktire, mpe kusumba bima ya nkaka ya mfunu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Third, demonetization has caused significant disruption to the economy.
target_text: Ya tatu, demonetisation ke kunata kubwa ya nene kimvwama.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Businesses had to close for days or even weeks while they adjusted to the new currency.
target_text: Bisalu ke kukangama bilumbu to balumingu mingi yina ba ke na kulonguka kusadila mbongo ya malumalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The dish is said to have originated in the Philippines, where it is known as lechon.
target_text: Ba me zonza ti ndonga ya madya katukaka na Philippines, kisika wapi ya me zabana mutindu lechon.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is also popular in other parts of Southeast Asia, such as Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand.
target_text: Ya me zabana mpe mingi na bizunga ya nkaka ya Asie ya Banda mutindu, Indonésie, Malaysie, mpe Thailande.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: To make lechon, a whole pig is gutted and cleaned, then stuffed with a mixture of garlic, ginger, lemongrass, and other spices.
target_text: Na kuyidika lechon, ba ke basisa bima ya yimbi na ngulu mpe kusukula yawu mbote, na manima ba ke fulusa yawu na kuvukisa ya ail, tangawisi, citronelle, mpe bambuma ya nkaka ya nsunga ya kitoko.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The pig is then roasted over a fire of charcoal or wood for several hours.
target_text: Ba ke tula ngulu na tiya ya makala to ya bayinti na bangunga mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The result is a juicy, flavorful meat that is perfect for a special occasion.
target_text: Ba ke kuzwa na manima ngombe ya kitoko mpe mezolakana yina me kulunga na kudya yawu na mukembo mosi ya kingenga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Lechon is often served with rice and vegetables.
target_text: Ba ke dyaka mingi lechon na loso mpe bandunda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It can also be eaten as a main course or as an appetizer.
target_text: Ba lenda mpe kudya yawu mutindu madya kaka mosi to madya ya nkotolo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If you are ever lucky enough to try lechon, you will not be disappointed.
target_text: Kana nge ke na dibaku mingi ya kumeka lechon, nge ke lemba nzutu ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is truly a unique and delicious dish.
target_text: Ya kele madya ya kingenga mpe ya kitoko.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In addition to the traditional method of cooking lechon, there are also several modern variations.
target_text: Na lweka ya kulamba lechon na mutindu ya bwala, badiswaswani kele mingingi na mbandu ya bubu yayi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Some chefs cook the pig in a pit oven, while others use a rotisserie.
target_text: Bamfumu ya madya ya nkaka kelambaka ngulu na four ya dibulu, na ntangu ba ya nkaka kesadilaka kuyoka na musoma.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are also recipes for making lechon in a slow cooker or in the oven.
target_text: Ya ke mpe na mutindu ya kulambila lechon na tiya ya fyoti to na fulu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: No matter how it is cooked, lechon is always a crowd-pleaser.
target_text: Konso mutindu be me kulambila yawu, lechon ke kuyangidikaka ntangu nyonso ndonga ya bantu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is a hearty and flavorful dish that is perfect for any occasion.
target_text: Ya ke madya ya kitoko mpe ya kilengi na kudya yina me delakana na konso mukembo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: So if you are looking for a new and exciting dish to try, lechon is definitely worth a look.
target_text: Kana nge ke na kusosa kumeka madya ya malumalu mpe ya kitoko mingi, ya me kulunga na nge na kulosa disu na lechon.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Me: What's up with your car? It's been making a weird noise lately.
target_text: Munu: Yinki me zwa kaminio ya nge? Ya vwandaka kusala makelele mosi ya yimbi ntama mingi ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Uncle: Yeah, I know. I'm taking it to the mechanic tomorrow.
target_text: Ngwankasi: Ee, Mu me zaba. Mu ke na kunata yawu na biyidi kaminio mbasi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Me: Is it going to be expensive.
target_text: Munu: Ba ke lomba ntalu mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Uncle: It might be. The car is old, and parts are hard to come by. But I'm hoping it's just a minor issue.
target_text: Ngwankasi: Ya lenda vwanda mutindu yina. Kaminio me nuna, mpe bisengo ya nkaka kele mpasi na kuzwa yawu. Kansi mu ke na kivuvu ti ya ke dyambu ya mpasi mingi ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Me: Well, good luck. Let me know what the mechanic says.
target_text: Munu: Matondo, dibaku ya mbote. Bika mu yufula yinki kisadi kaminio me kuzonza.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Uncle: I will. Thanks.
target_text: Ngwankasi: Mu ke sala yawu. Matondo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Me: Hey, by the way, did you know that nuclear cars are a thing?
target_text: Munu: E, na yina, nge me zaba ti bakaminio ya nucleaire kele kima mosi?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Uncle: No, I didn't. That's interesting.
target_text: Ngwankasi: Ve, Mu me zaba ve. Ya ke dyambu ya mboté.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Me: Yeah, they're pretty cool. They use nuclear power to generate electricity, which powers the car's motor.
target_text: Munu: Ee, Yawu ke kitoko mingi. Yawu ke sadilaka ngolo ya nucleaire samu na kupesa kura, yina ke pesa ngolo na motele ya kaminio.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Uncle: That sounds like it would be really expensive.
target_text: Ngwakasi: Ya ke na kutalana ti ya lenda vwanda ntalu mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Me: It can be, but it's also a lot more efficient than traditional cars. Nuclear cars can go for hundreds of miles on a single tank of fuel.
target_text: Munu: Ya lenda vwanda mutindu yina, kansi ya ke tambulaka mbote mingi kulutila bakaminio ya ntama. Bakaminio ya nucleaire lenda tambula yinda ya bametele nkama zole na mwa kibumbulu mazuti ya fyoti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Uncle: Hmm, I'll have to look into that.
target_text: Ngwankasi: Hmm, Mu ke kutala yawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A man walks into a comedy club and orders a filet mignon.
target_text: Bakala mosi vwandaka tambula yinzo ya kusekisa mpe sosaka kusumba ndambu ya musuni ya ngulu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The waiter brings him the steak and he starts to eat it.
target_text: Kikabudi madya me natina yandi musuni ya ngombe ba me kalinga mpe yandi me banda kudya yawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: After a few bites, he stops and says, "This steak is terrible! It's tough and tasteless."
target_text: Na manima ya kudya mwa misuni, yandi me bita mpe me tuba, "Musuni ya ngombe ke yimbi mingi! Ya ke ngolo mpe ya kele ve na kelengi."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The waiter replies, "Well, sir, you did order a filet mignon."
target_text: Kikabudi madya me vutula, "Ee, tata bakala, nge mosi tumisaka musuni ya ngulu."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Yes, but I didn't order a raw filet mignon!"
target_text: "Ni yawu, kansi mutumisaka ve musuni ya ngulu ya nkunzu!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Sir, all of our steaks are served raw. We require our customers to cook them themselves."
target_text: "Tata bakala, misuni ya ngombe ya beto nyonso ke ya nkunzu. Beto kelombaka na bakiliya ya beto na kulamba yawu bawu mosi."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "But I don't know how to cook!"
target_text: "Kansi mu me zaba ve kulamba!"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "That's not our problem. We're a comedy club, not a restaurant."
target_text: "Ya me kutala beto ve. Beto ke epike ya kusekisa bantu, yinzo ke tekisaka madya ve."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The man angrily gets up and storms out of the club.
target_text: Bakala telamaka na nganzi mpe basikaka na kutekita nyonso na kati ya yinzo ya kusekisa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He had been in a car accident, and he was unconscious.
target_text: Ba dyataka yandi ya kaminio, mpe nsimu katukaka yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: His parents, who had been driving by when the accident happened, rushed to his side.
target_text: Bibuti ya yandi, yina ba vwandaka luta na kisika aksida salamaka, kimaka mbangu na kisika ya yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They were frantic with worry.
target_text: Bawu vwandaka tala boma na mayindu kidi-kidi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The paramedics arrived and loaded the boy into an ambulance.
target_text: Bakaminio ya lupitalu kumaka mpe kunayaka mwana fyoti ya bakala na yawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: His parents followed in their car, their hearts pounding with fear.
target_text: Bibuti ya bawu landaka na kaminio ya bawu, bantima ya bawu vwandaka tuta ngolo na boma.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: At the hospital, the doctors examined the boy and determined that he had a concussion and a broken leg.
target_text: Na lupitalu, badokotolo fimbaka mwana ya bakala mpe kwizaka kutala ti yandi vwandaka na mpasi ya yitu mpe dikulu ya yandi zenganaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They admitted him to the hospital and began treatment.
target_text: Ba simbaka yandi na lupitalu mpe yandi bandala kuzwa manganga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The boy's parents stayed by his side, never leaving him alone.
target_text: Bibuti ya mwana ya bakala vwandaka na lweka ya yandi, ata fyoti ba bikaka yandi mosi ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They watched over him as he slept, their hearts filled with love and hope.
target_text: Ba vwandaka sala lukengolo ya yandi ntangu yandi vwandaka lala, bantima ya bawu fulukaka na zola mpe kivuvu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Royalty," said the Blacksmith, "is a curious thing. It's a kind of magic, really.
target_text: Blacksmith me tuba,"Mfuka," kele kima ya ngitukulu. Ya tsieleka, ya ke mutindu mpandu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: People get all worked up about it, and they don't even know why.
target_text: Bantu ke salaka nyonso samu na yawu, mpe bawu me kuzaba ve samu na yinki.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It's not as if kings and queens have any real power, these days. They're just figureheads.
target_text: Ya kele ve mutindu kaka bantinu mpe bakento ya bantinu kele na ngolo ya kuyadila, bilumbu yayi. Bawu ke kaka bimonikisi ya mpamba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: But people still seem to need them.
target_text: Kansi bantu ke ntete na nsatu ya bawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They need someone to look up to, someone to represent the idea of the nation." The Blacksmith paused.
target_text: Ba ke na nsatu ya muntu ke na ndyatulu ya mbote, muntu yina ke na kumonikisa dibanza ya yinsi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "I suppose it's a kind of comfort," he continued.
target_text: Yandi tatamanaka kuzonza, "Mu me kanisa ti ya ke mutindu ya kisika ya kitoko."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "To know that there's someone out there who's better than you.
target_text: "Kuzaba ti ya ke na muntu kuna yina kele mbote kulutila nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Someone who's got it all sorted out.
target_text: Muntu me kubakusa nyonso yina me tala nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Someone who can make the world a better place.
target_text: Muntu mosi yina lenda sala ti yinza kukuma kisika ya mbote ya kuvwandila.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Of course, it's all an illusion. But that doesn't make it any less important.
target_text: Ya tsieleka, nyonso ke kaka luvunu. Kansi ya ke na kusala ve ti ya vwanda mfunu mingi ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: People need their illusions. They need to believe in something.
target_text: Bantu ke na nsatu ya luvunu ya bawu. Ba zola kukwikila na kima mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: And if that something is a king or a queen, then so be it."
target_text: Mpe kana kima mosi yina ke ntinu mosi to kento ya ntinu, ya ke vwanda mbote."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The Blacksmith paused for a moment, then smiled.
target_text: Blacksmith pemaka mwa fyoti, mpe na manima ba sekaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The Old Man and the Sea
target_text: Kiboba na Nzadi ya nene
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Santiago, an old Cuban fisherman, has gone eighty-four days without catching a fish.
target_text: Santiago, kilobi mbisi ya mbuta ya yinsi ya Cuba, kwendaka bilumbu makumi nana na yiya kondwa kuzwa mbisi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He is the oldest man in the village, and the youngest, Manolin, no longer wants to fish with him because the old man is unlucky.
target_text: Yandi ke mbuta muntu me lutila kununa na bwala, mpe muntu me lutila kuvwanda twenia, kele Manolin, yandi ke zolaka ata fyoti ve kuloba mbisi ya yandi, samu mbuta muntu ke na bueso ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One day, Santiago sets out in his skiff and hooks a giant marlin.
target_text: Kilumbu mosi, Santiago me kwenda ya bota ya yandi na me loba mbisi ba ke bokilaka marlin ya nene.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The marlin is so big that it pulls the skiff far out to sea.
target_text: Marlin me kulutila nene mpe me nata bota ntama na nzadi ya nene.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Santiago fights the marlin for two days and nights, but he cannot bring it in.
target_text: Santiago me nwana na marlin bilumbu zole mpe bampimpa mingi, kansi yandi lembanaka kukotisa yandi na bota.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The marlin is too heavy, and the old man is too tired.
target_text: Marlin kele kilo mingi, mpe mbuta muntu me kulutila kulemba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Finally, the marlin begins to tire.
target_text: Na nsuka, marlin bandaka kulemba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Santiago is able to get a harpoon into the marlin, and he kills it.
target_text: Santiago me tobula marlin munduki ya bambisi mpe me kufwa yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: But the marlin is so big that Santiago cannot bring it into the boat.
target_text: Kansi marlin vwandaka kilo mingi yawu me sala ti Santiago lendaka ve kukotisa yandi na bota.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He ties the marlin to the side of the boat and begins to row back to shore.
target_text: Yandi kangaka marlin na lweka ya bota mpe bandaka kunata bota na simu ya nzadi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A school of sharks follows the boat, and they begin to eat the marlin.
target_text: Ba requin mingi vwandaka landa bota, mpe ba bandaka kudya marlin.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Santiago fights the sharks off, but he cannot stop them all.
target_text: Santiago nwanaka na kukatula barequin, kansi lendaka ve kukatula bawu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: By the time he reaches shore, only the head and the tail of the marlin are left.
target_text: Na ntangu yandi kumaka na simu ya nzadi, kaka yitu na mukila ya marlin bikanaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The police will likely take the person to the station and question him.
target_text: Ntembe kele ve nde bapolisi ta nata muntu na biro mpi bo ta yula yandi bangiufula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They will want to know where he got the wallet and why he was carrying it.
target_text: Bo ta sosa kuzaba kisika yandi bakaka potomone mpi sambu na nki yo vandaka na maboko na yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If the person cannot provide a satisfactory explanation, he may be arrested and charged with theft.
target_text: Kana muntu yango kupesa ve ntendula ya pwelele, bo lenda kanga yandi mpi kutuba nde yandi yibaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If the person is arrested, he will be taken to jail and held until his trial.
target_text: Kana bo me kanga muntu, bo ta nata yandi na boloko mpi yandi ta vanda kuna tii ntangu bo ta sambisa yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: At his trial, the prosecution will have to prove beyond a reasonable doubt that he is guilty of theft.
target_text: Na ntangu ya kusambisa yandi, bantu ya me funda yandi fwete ndimisa pwelele nde yandi yibaka mpenza.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The defense will have the opportunity to present evidence and witnesses that may help to exonerate the person.
target_text: Muntu ya bo me funda ta vanda ti dibaku ya kupesa banzikisa mpi kubasisa batemoin yina lenda sadisa na kuyambula yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If the person is found guilty, he may be sentenced to jail time, probation, or community service.
target_text: Kana bo me mona nde muntu yango salaka kifu, bo lenda zengila yandi nkanu ya boloko, kufutisa yandi amande, to kulomba yandi na kusala bisalu na kisika yandi ke vandaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He may also be ordered to pay restitution to the victim of the theft.
target_text: Bo lenda lomba yandi mpi na kufuta muntu yina yandi yibaka bima.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In some cases, the person may be able to avoid criminal charges by entering into a diversion program.
target_text: Na bambandu ya nkaka, yandi lenda nunga na kupusa bo na kutuba yandi salaka ve kifu ya ngolo kana yandi kota na manaka ya bo ke bingaka dejudiciarisation.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Diversion programs are designed to help people who have committed minor crimes avoid the criminal justice system.
target_text: Bo me salaka manaka ya dejudiciarisation sambu na kusadisa bantu yina salaka bifu ya fioti na kukonda ve na ngidika ya kusamba mambu ya crime.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In a diversion program, the person may be required to complete community service, pay restitution, or attend counseling.
target_text: Na programe ya dejudiriciarisation, bo lenda lomba muntu na kusala bisalu na kisika yandi ke vandaka, na kufuta mbongo, to na kubaka bandongisila.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If the person is found not guilty, he will be released from jail and the charges against him will be dropped.
target_text: Kana bo me mona nde muntu salaka ve kifu, bo ta basisa yandi na boloko mpi bo ta katula mambu yina bo fundilaka yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He will be able to go on with his life without a criminal record.
target_text: Yandi ta landa kuzinga kukonda kuvanda ti bifu ya crime na dosie na yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is important to note that the above is just a general overview of what may happen to a presumed thief who is held by police.
target_text: Yo kele mfunu mingi na kuzaba nde mambu ya bo me tubila na zulu kele kaka bunkufi ya mambu yina lenda kumina muntu ya bo me kanga nde bapolisi sambu bo ke yindula nde yandi me yiba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The specific circumstances of each case will vary, and the outcome may depend on a number of factors, such as the evidence available, the person's criminal history, and the judge or jury's decision.
target_text: Ba circonstance ya konso diambu ke swaswanaka, mpe resultat lenda tadila mambu mingi, mu mbandu banzikisa ya bo kele ti yo, bacrime yina muntu yango me salaka, mpe lukanu ya zuzi to ya jury.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The couple, a renowned linguist and a world-renowned pastry chef, had been trying for a baby for years.
target_text: Bakala ti nkento, kele bantu ya me zaba ndinga mbote mpi balambi ya me kwenda nsangu ntoto ya mvimba, bo vandaka kusosa kubuta mwana banda bamvula mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They had been to every doctor and specialist they could find, but nothing seemed to work.
target_text: Bo me kutanaka ti minganga mpi ba specialiste yonso yina bo me zaba kansi yo vandaka kumonana nde yo ke simba ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The linguist was starting to lose hope, and the pastry chef was worried that their reputation would be ruined if they couldn't have a child.
target_text: Muntu ya me zaba ndinga mbote yantikaka kuvidisa kivuvu, mpe mulambi ya me kwenda nsangu vandaka kudiyangisa sambu lukumu na bo ta beba kana bo ke kaka ve ti mwana.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One day, the linguist was working on a new translation of a difficult poem when he had a breakthrough.
target_text: Kilumbu mosi, muntu ya me zaba ndinga mbote vandaka kusala kisalu ya kubalula poemi mosi ya mpasi ebuna yandi monaka kima mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He realized that the key to having a child was to find a way to combine their two passions.
target_text: Yandi bakisaka nde sambu bo buta mwana bo zole fwete sosa mpila ya kuvukisa mambu yina zole yina bo ke zolaka mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He called the pastry chef and told her his idea.
target_text: Yandi bingaka mulambi mpi songaka yandi ngindu na yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The pastry chef was skeptical at first, but she agreed to give it a try.
target_text: Mulambi vandaka ti badute na luyantiku, kansi yandi ndimaka na kumeka yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They spent the next few months working on a new recipe for a cake that would be infused with the linguist's love of language and the pastry chef's love of baking.
target_text: Bo lutisaka bangonda yina landaka na kumeka kusala formile ya mpa ya kusala gato yina ta vukisa zola ya bandinga ya muntu ya me zaba ndinga mbote mpe zola ya kusala bagato ya mulambi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When the cake was finally finished, they took it to the premier of a new play that the linguist was translating.
target_text: Ntangu bo manisaka kusala gato, bo nataka yo na kima ya ntete yina muntu ya me zaba bandinga mbot vandaka kubalula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They waited until the after-party, and then they cut the cake and served it to everyone.
target_text: Bo vingilaka tii na nsima ya feti, ebuna bo zengaka gato mpe bo pesaka yo na bantu yonso.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The cake was a huge hit.
target_text: Bantu sepelaka mpenza ti gato yina.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Everyone loved the taste, and they were all impressed by the story behind it.
target_text: Bantu yonso sepelaka ti ntomo na yo, mpe bo yitukaka na kuzaba kima yina pusaka bo na kusala yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Hockey is a fast-paced, physical sport that is played on ice.
target_text: Hockey kele nsaka ya ntinu mingi, ya ke lomba ngolo mingi yina bo ke salaka na glase.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is played with two teams of six players each, with one goaltender.
target_text: Bo ke bulaka yo na baekipe zole; konso ekipe ke vandaka ti bantu sambanu, mpi gardien.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The object of the game is to score goals by shooting the puck into the opponent's net.
target_text: Lukanu ya nsaka kele ya kutula ba but na kokotisaka rondelle to palet na fillet ya bambeni.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Hockey is a popular sport in Canada, the United States, and Europe.
target_text: Bantu ke zolaka Hockey mingi na Canada, na Etats-Unis mpi na Erope.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is also an Olympic sport.
target_text: Yo kele mpi nsaka ya Olympique.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The first indoor hockey game was played in Montreal, Canada, in 1875.
target_text: Nsaka ya ntete ya kati ya nzo bulamaka na Montreal na Canada, na 1875.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The National Hockey League (NHL) was established in 1917.
target_text: Bo salaka Ligue Nationale ya Hockey (NHL) na 1917.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Hockey is a demanding sport that requires a high level of skill and athleticism.
target_text: Hockey kele nsaka yina ke lombaka mayele mingi mpi ngolo mingi ya nitu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Players must be able to skate, shoot, pass, and stickhandle at a high level.
target_text: Ba joueur fwete tambula, kubula, kusala bapasse, mpe kusadila nti ya nsaka na nivo ya zulu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They must also be able to think quickly and make split-second decisions.
target_text: Bo fwete kuka mpi kuyindula nswalu mpi kubaka balukanu ntina mpenza.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Hockey is a great sport for people of all ages.
target_text: Hockey kele nsaka ya mbote sambu na bantu ya bamvula yonso.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is a fun and challenging way to stay active.
target_text: Yo kele mutindu ya ke pesa kiese mpi ya mpasi ya kubikala actif.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Were it within my power to impart to you the incredibly detailed information concerning my deepest fear, I would do so without hesitation.
target_text: Ntangu mono kele ti kiyeka ya kupesa nge bansangu ya fioti-fioti ya kuyituka ya me tala baboma na mono ya ngolo, mono ta salaka kukonda badute.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: However, such knowledge is not mine to give.
target_text: Ata mpidina, mono ve muntu fwete pesa mayele yina.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Suffice it to say that my greatest dread is something so insidious and far-reaching that it defies description.
target_text: Yo me fwana na kutuba nde boma na mono ya ngolo kuluta kele kima mosi ya kubumbana mpi ya nene kibeni yo yina mpila ya kutendula yo kele ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is a terror that lurks in the shadows, waiting to pounce at the most unexpected moment.
target_text: Yo kele boma yina ke tambulaka na mudidi, yo ke vingilaka na kubasika na ntangu yina bantu ke yindula ve ata fioti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is a predator that feeds on my very essence, leaving me feeling weak and vulnerable.
target_text: Yo kele muzombi yina ke dyaka mono na kati mpi ke bikaka mono ya kulemba mpi kukonda ngolo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This insidious fear has been with me for as long as I can remember.
target_text: Boma yai ya kubumbana ke vandaka na kati na mono banda ntama mpenza.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It has shaped my life in ways that I am only beginning to understand.
target_text: Yo me yidikaka luzingu na mono na mitindu yina mono me yantika kubakisa ntama ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I have become a recluse, afraid to venture out into the world lest I come face to face with my worst nightmare.
target_text: Mono me kuma muntu yina ke zingaka yandi mosi, mono ke waka boma ya kubasika na nsi-ntoto sambu mono ke waka boma nde mono ta kutana ti ndosi na mono ya mbi kuluta.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I have lost friends and family, and my relationships have suffered.
target_text: Mono me vidisaka banduku mpi dibuta, mpi yo me bebisaka bangwisana na mono.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I am constantly on edge, waiting for the other shoe to drop.
target_text: Mono ke vandaka ntangu yonso mayele, mono ke vingilaka nde mambu ya mbi kusalama.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I know that I am not alone in my suffering.
target_text: Mono me zaba nde mono ke niokwamaka ve mono mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are others who share my burden.
target_text: Kele ti bantu zole yina ke monaka mpi mpasi na mono.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We are a community of the damned, united by our fear.
target_text: Beto kele kimvuka ya bantu ya mawa, yina boma me vukisaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We are the ones who walk in the shadows, afraid of the light.
target_text: Beto kele bantu yina ke tambulaka na mudidi, beto ke waka nsemo boma.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We are the ones who are haunted by the past, and who live in fear of the future.
target_text: Beto kele bantu yina luzingu ya ntama ke zombaka, mpe yina ke zingaka ti boma ya avenire.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grandmother is sitting in her rocking chair, knitting a sweater.
target_text: Nkaka ya nkento me vandaka na kiti na yandi ya ke balukaka, yandi ke sala triko.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Her granddaughter, a teenager, is sitting on the couch, watching TV.
target_text: Mutekolo na yandi ya nkento, yandi kele toko, me vanda na kiti, yandi ke tala TV.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grandmother: I remember when I was your age, we didn't have any of these fancy gadgets.
target_text: Nkaka ya nkento: Mono ke yibuka ntango mono vandaka ti mvula na nge, beto vandaka ve ti bima yai yonso ya kusakanina.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We had to go outside and play.
target_text: Beto vandaka kubasika na nganda mpi kusakana.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Granddaughter: I know, Grandma. You've told me that story a million times.
target_text: Mutekolo ya nkento: Nkaka, me zaba. Nge me budilaka mono disolo mbala mingi mpenza.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grandmother: Well, it's true!
target_text: Nkaka ya nkento: Ee, yo ke masonga!
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We had to use our imaginations to have fun.
target_text: Yo vandaka kulomba kusadila bangindu na beto sambu na kudisepedisa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We didn't have all these video games and computers to entertain us.
target_text: Beto vandaka ve ti bansaka yonso yai ya bavideo mpi ba ordinatere sambu na kusakana.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Granddaughter: But I like video games and computers. They're fun.
target_text: Mutekolo ya nkento: Kansi mono ke zolaka bansaka ya bavideo mpi ba ordinatere. Yo ke kitoko mpenza.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grandmother: I'm not saying they're not fun, but they're not the same as playing outside.
target_text: Nkaka ya nkento: Mono ke tuba ve nde yo kele ve mbote, kansi yo kele ve mutindu mosi ti kusakana na nganda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When you play outside, you get exercise and you meet new people.
target_text: Ntangu nge ke sakana na nganda, nge ke sala ngalasisi mpi ke kutana ti bantu ya mpa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Granddaughter: I know, Grandma. But I still like video games.
target_text: Mutekolo ya nkento: Nkaka, me zaba. Kansi mono ke zolaka mingi bansaka ya video.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grandmother: Well, I guess you're just a product of your generation.
target_text: Nkaka ya nkento: Kima ve, mono ke bakisa nde nge kele kaka kima ya generation na beno.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Granddaughter: I guess so.
target_text: Mutekolo ya nkento: Mono ke yindula mpidina mpi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: [Grandmother smiles and goes back to knitting.
target_text: [Nkaka ya nkento me mweta mpi me vutukila kutunga triko.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Granddaughter goes back to watching TV.]
target_text: Mutekolo ya nkento me vutukila kutala TV.]
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The influences of religion on music are vast and varied.
target_text: Bupusi ya lusambu na miziki kele ya ngolo mpi ya mitindu mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: From the chanting of hymns in ancient temples to the soaring melodies of gospel songs, music has long been used to express religious beliefs and emotions.
target_text: Banda na bankunga ya bahymne na batempelo ya ntama tii na miziki ya kitoko ya bankunga ya gospel, bantu ke sadilaka miziki banda ntama sambu na kumonsa balukwikilu mpi mawi ya lusambu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In many religions, music is seen as a way to connect with the divine.
target_text: Na mabundu mingi, bo ke monaka miziki bonso nzila ya kuwakana ti Nzambi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The sounds and rhythms of music can create a sense of awe and reverence, and can help to transport the listener to a higher plane of consciousness.
target_text: Makelelele mpi rythme ya miziki lenda sadila muntu na kuwa boma mpi kukumisa Nzambi, mpe yo lenda nata muntu ya ke widikila na kisika ya kuzanguka ya kuzaba mambu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: For example, in Hinduism, music is considered to be a form of yoga.
target_text: Mu mbandu, na lusambu ya bamizlma, bo ke monaka miziki bonso mutindu mosi ya yoga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The practice of kirtan, or devotional chanting, is said to help to purify the mind and open the heart to the divine.
target_text: Bo ke tuba nde, kusadila kirtan, to bankunga ya kukumisa Nzambi, ke sadisaka na kukumisa mabanza bunkete mpi kukangudila Nzambi ntima.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In Buddhism, music is often used as a form of meditation, helping to focus the mind and bring about a state of calm and tranquility.
target_text: Na dibundu ya bantu ya Budha, bo ke sadilaka miziki mbala mingi bonso mutindu mosi ya kuyindulula; yo ke sadisaka na kutula bangindu kisika mosi mpi kusadisa na kuvanda pima mpi na ngemba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In addition to its spiritual role, music can also be used to address social and political issues.
target_text: Katula mukumba na yo ya kimpeve, miziki lenda sadilama mpi na kutubila mambu ya luzingu mpi ya politiki.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In the civil rights movement, for example, music played a powerful role in mobilizing people and inspiring them to fight for justice.
target_text: Mu mbandu, na mivuma ya kunwanina banswa ya bantu, miziki sadisaka mingi na kuvukisa bantu mpi kupusa bo na kunwanina lunungu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The songs of Martin Luther King Jr, Mahalia Jackson, and others helped to give voice to the hopes and dreams of African Americans, and helped to bring about a more just and equitable society.
target_text: Bankunga ya Martin Luther King Jr, Michail Jackson mpi ya bantu ya nkaka sadisaka na kutubila bivuvu mpi bandosi ya bantu ya Amerika ya me katukaka na Afrika, mpi yo me sadisaka na kuvanda ti kimvuka ya lunungu mpi ya bukatikati.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The peacock is a large and colorful bird that is native to Asia.
target_text: Paon kele ndenge ya nene mpi ya mikubu mingi yina me katukaka na Asie.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is known for its beautiful plumage, which is made up of iridescent blue, green, and purple feathers.
target_text: Yo me zabanaka sambu na mansala na yo ya kitoko, yina me salama na mansala ya bleu, ya vert mpi ya violet.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Peacocks are also known for their elaborate courtship displays, which they perform to attract mates.
target_text: Bapaon me zabanaka mpi sambu na mambu ya kuyituka ya bo ke salaka sambu na kumonisa zola, yina bo ke salaka sambu na kubenda bankwelani.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: During these displays, the male peacock will spread his tail feathers and fan them out to create a large, colorful fan.
target_text: Ntangu bo ke salaka mambu yai, paon ya bakala ke basisaka mansala ya mukila na yo mpi ke panzaka sambu yo sala ventilateur ya nene mpi ya mikubu mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The female peacock will then choose a mate based on the size and beauty of his tail feathers.
target_text: Ebuna paon ya nkento ke ponaka bakala na kulanda nene mpi kitoko ya mansala ya mukila na yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Peacocks are also known for their intelligence and ability to learn.
target_text: Bapaon me zabanaka mpi sambu na mayele mpi makuki na bo ya kulonguka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They can be trained to perform tricks and can even be taught to talk.
target_text: Bo lenda longa bo na kusala mambu mingi mpi bo lenda longa bo nkutu na kutuba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In addition to their beauty and intelligence, peacocks are also important members of the ecosystem.
target_text: Katula kitoko mpi mayele na bo, bapaon kele mpi mfunu mingi na luzingu awa na ntoto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They help to control the population of insects and other pests, and their droppings can help to fertilize the soil.
target_text: Bo ke sadisaka na kulandila baniama ya fioti mpi tubaniama ya nkaka, mpi tufi na bo lenda sadila sambu ntoto kubuta bima mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I sit on the edge of the bed, my feet dangling over the side.
target_text: Mono me vanda na lweka ya mbeto, makulu ke lela na ndambu ya nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The air is thick with the smell of sweat and sex.
target_text: Mupepe me fuluka ti nsudi ya mutoki mpi ya kuvukisa nitu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The sheets are tangled around my legs, and I can feel the warm imprint of his body on the mattress next to me.
target_text: Badrap me kanga makulu na mono, mpi mono ke wa tiya ya nitu na yandi na matela ya kele pene-pene na mono.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I reach for the postcard on the nightstand and write my name and address on the front.
target_text: Mono me baka karte ya poste na zulu ya mesa ya mpimpa mpi mono me sonika zina ti adresi na mono na zulu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Then I turn it over and begin to write "Dearest Ted," I write. "I'm having the time of my life here in Italy.
target_text: Ebuna mono me balusa yo mpi me yantika kusonika "Mpangi Ted," mono me sonika. "Mono ke lutisa ntangu ya mbote kibeni ya luzingu na mono awa na Italie.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The weather is perfect, the food is delicious, and the people are so friendly.
target_text: Mupepe kele mbote mingi, madia kele ntomo, mpi bantu kele luzingu mpenza.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I've been swimming in the ocean, exploring the ruins of ancient cities, and eating the best things the country has to offer."
target_text: Mono me nager na ocean, mono me tala mayumbu ya bambanza ya ntama, mpi me dia madia ya kitoko kuluta ya insi yai."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I think of Ted's disintrest in outdoor activities and his bland cooking. I glance at Alfonso.
target_text: Mono ke yindula mpila Ted ke zolaka ve kusala mambu na nganda mpi kulamba na yandi ya mbi. Mono me tala Alfonso.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "I'm enclosing this postcard with a picture of the beach where I'm staying.
target_text: "Mono ke tinda karte yai ya poste ti foto ya dibungu kisika mono ke vanda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It's a beautiful spot, with white sand and crystal-clear water."
target_text: Yo kele kisika ya kitoko; yo kele ti zelo ya mpembe mpi masa ya mpembe ya ngolo."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The history of Cameroon is long and complex, dating back to the earliest human settlements in the region.
target_text: Disolo ya Cameroun kele ya nda mpi ya mindondo; yo me yantika ntangu bantu ya ntete kwisaka kuvanda na kisika yai.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The area was first settled by Bantu peoples around 3000 BCE, and it was later conquered by the Kanem-Bornu Empire in the 11th century.
target_text: Bantu ya bo ke bingaka ba Bantu kele bantu ya ntete yina zingaka kuna pene-pene ya mvu 3000 na ntwala ya ntangu na beto, mpi na nima Kimfumu ya Kanem-Bornu botulaka yo na 11 siekle.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In the 15th century, the Portuguese arrived in Cameroon and established trade relations with the local people.
target_text: Na 15 siekle, bantu ya Portugal kumaka na Cameroun mpi salaka bangwisana ya mumbongo ti bankwa-bwala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The region was later colonized by Germany in the 1880s, and it became a German colony known as Kamerun.
target_text: Na nima bantu ya Allemagne yalaka yo na bamvu 1880, mpi yo kumaka bwala ya kimpika ya Allemagne; bo vandaka kubinga yo Kamerun.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: During World War I, Cameroon was occupied by British and French forces, and it was divided between the two countries after the war.
target_text: Na Mvita ya Ntete ya Ntoto ya Mvimba, basoda ya Grande-Bretagne mpi ya France botulaka Cameroun, mpi bo bansi zole yina kabulaka yo na nima ya bitumba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The British-controlled region became known as Southern Cameroons, while the French-controlled region became known as French Cameroon.
target_text: Bo kumaka kubinga kitini yina Grande-Bretagne vandaka kuyala nde Cameoroun ya sud, kansi kitini yina ba Français vandaka kuyala bo kumaka kubinga yo Cameroun ya Français.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In 1960, Southern Cameroons became independent from Britain, and it merged with French Cameroon to form the Federal Republic of Cameroon.
target_text: Na 1960, Cameroun ya sud bakaka kimpwanza na Grande-Bretagne mpi yo vukankaka ti Cameroun ya Français ebuna yo salaka Repibliki Federale ya Cameroun.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In 1972, the federal system was abolished and Cameroon became a unitary state.
target_text: Na 1972, bo fwaka ngidika ya federale ebuna Cameroun ya mvimba kumaka bwala mosi ya kimvuka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Cameroon has experienced a number of political and economic challenges in recent years.
target_text: Cameroun me kutanaka ti bampasi mingi ya politiki mpi ya mbongo na bamvula ya me katuka kuluta.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Mystery surrounds disappearance of Eva Green.
target_text: Kuvila ya Eva Green kele diswekamu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Eva Green, a 25-year-old woman from London, has been missing for over a week.
target_text: Eva Green, mwana-nkento ya Londres ya kele ti bamvu 25, ke monana ve banda mposo kuluta mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She was last seen on February 25th, leaving her apartment in the city's Notting Hill neighborhood.
target_text: Bo monaka yandi na mbala ya nsuka na le 25 février, yandi ke basika na apartema na yandi na kartie ya Notting Hill na ville.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Green is described as being 5'6" tall, with long brown hair and green eyes.
target_text: Bo ke tuba nde Gren kele ti nda ya 1,68m, yandi kele ti nsuki ya mbwaki mpi meso ya vert.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She was last seen wearing a black coat, jeans, and a white t-shirt.
target_text: Bo monaka yandi mbala ya nsuka yandi me lwata kazaka ya ndombe, jeans, mpi triko ya mpembe.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Police have said that they are concerned for Green's safety and are asking anyone with information about her whereabouts to come forward.
target_text: Polisi ke tuba nde bo ke kudiyangisa sambu na lutaninu ya Green mpi bo ke lomba konso muntu yina me zaba kisika yandi kele na kukwisa kusonga bo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Green's family and friends are desperate for news of her.
target_text: Bampangi ti banduku ya Green kele ti nzala ya ngolo ya kubaka bansangu na yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They have been posting flyers and distributing missing person's posters around the city.
target_text: Bo ke kutula ba ffiche mpi ke kabula bafoto ya muntu ya me vila na bwala ya mvimba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They have also set up a Facebook page to help spread the word about her disappearance.
target_text: Bo me kangula mpi lutiti ya Facebook sambu na kusadisa na kupanza nsangu ya me tala kuvila na yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The police have not yet released any information about possible suspects or motives in Green's disappearance.
target_text: Polisi me basisa ntete ve bantu ya me tala bantu yina mbala ya nkaka salaka yandi mbi to bikuma ya kuvila ya Green.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They are asking anyone with information to come forward, no matter how small.
target_text: Bo ke lomba konso muntu yina kele ti bansangu na kukwisa kutuba, ata yo kele bansangu ya fioti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Green's disappearance is a mystery, but her family and friends are hopeful that she will be found safe and sound.
target_text: Kuvila ya Green kele diswekamu, kansi bampangi ti banduku na yandi ke tula ntima nde bo ta mona yandi na lutaninu mpi ti sante ya mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Trimming your dog's nails is a necessary part of grooming, but it can be a daunting task for some pet owners.
target_text: Kuzenga manzungulu ya mbwa na nge kele kitini ya mfunu ya kuyitika nitu na yandi, kansi yo lenda vanda kusala ya mpasi mingi sambu na bantu mingi ya kele ti banyama.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If you're not sure how to trim your dog's nails, don't worry - it's easier than you think.
target_text: Kana nge me zaba ve mpila ya kuzenga manzungulu ya mbwa na nge, kudiyangisa ve - yo kele pete kuluta mpila nge ke yindula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The first step is to gather your supplies.
target_text: Kitambi ya ntete kele kubaka bisadilu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You'll need a pair of sharp scissors or a nail clipper, a styptic powder or pencil, and a towel.
target_text: Nge ta vanda ti mfunu ya cisseaux ya kele ti makasi to ya kima ya kuzengila manzungulu, ya poudre to ya crayon mpi ya esume.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Next, you'll need to clip your dog's nails in a comfortable place.
target_text: Na nima, nge fwete zenga manzungulu ya mbwa na nge na kisika ya mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If your dog is nervous, try clipping their nails in a quiet room where they can't see out the window.
target_text: Kana mbwa na nge kele na makasi, meka kuzenga yandi manzungulu na suku ya pima kisika yandi ke mona ve nganda na nzila ya fenetre.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You may also want to have someone help you hold your dog still.
target_text: Nge lenda vanda mpi ti mfunu ya muntu sambu yandi kanga mbwa sambu yo nikana ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: To trim your dog's nails, start by gently grasping their paw.
target_text: Zenga manzungulu ya mbwana na nge, banda na kusimba makulu na yo na mawete.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Then, use your scissors or clippers to clip the tip of the nail.
target_text: Na nima, sadila cissaux to bima ya kuzengila manzungulu sambu na kuzenga manzungulu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Be careful not to cut too short, as this can cause pain and bleeding.
target_text: Kuzenga yo ve yo bikala nkufu mingi sambu yo lenda sala yandi mpasi mpi kubasisa menga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If you do cut your dog's nail too short, apply a styptic powder or pencil to stop the bleeding.
target_text: Kana nge zenga manzungulu ya mbwa na nge yo bikala nkufi mingi, tula poudre to crayon sambu menga kumana kubasika.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Styptic powders and pencils are available at most pet stores.
target_text: Bapoudre mpi bacrayon ke vandaka na bamagasin mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Once you've trimmed all of your dog's nails, be sure to reward them with a treat.
target_text: Na nima ya kuzenga manzungulu ya mbwa na nge, kuvila ve kupesa yandi mwa kado.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Trimming nails can be a stressful experience for some dogs, so it's important to make it a positive experience.
target_text: Kuzenga manzungulu lenda yangisa mingi mpenza bambwa ya nkaka, yo yina yo kele mfunu mingi na kusala nde yo luta mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: With a little practice, you'll be able to trim your dog's nails like a pro.
target_text: Kana nge meka mwa fioti, nge ta kuka kuzenga manzungulu ya mbwa na nge bonso muntu ya me zaba kisalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: And your dog will be happy to have their nails trimmed, too!
target_text: Mbwa na nge ta sepela mpi mpila nge ta zenga yandi manzungulu!
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Here are a few additional tips for trimming your dog's nails:
target_text: Tala bandongisila ya nkaka ya me tala kuzenga mbwa manzungulu:
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: * Start by trimming the nails on your dog's front paws.
target_text: * Banda na kuzenga manzungulu ya makulu ya ntwala ya mbwa na nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This is usually the easiest place to start.
target_text: Yo ke vandaka mbala mingi kisika ya pete ya kuyantika.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: * If your dog is nervous, try trimming their nails one at a time.
target_text: * Kana mbwa na nge ke na makasi, meka kuzenga dinzungulu mosi-mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: * Be sure to trim the nails evenly.
target_text: * Kuvila kuzenga manzungulu yo vanda nda kiteso mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You don't want one nail to be shorter than the others.
target_text: Dinzungulu mosi fwete vanda ve nkufi kuluta ya nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: * If you're not sure how to trim your dog's nails, ask your veterinarian or a groomer for help.
target_text: * Kana nge me zaba ve mpila ya kuzenga manzungulu ya mbwa na nge, lomba lusadisu ya vegetarien to ya coiffeur na nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: With a little care and attention, you can keep your dog's nails trimmed and healthy.
target_text: Kana nge tula dikebi, nge lenda sala nde manzungulu ya mbwa na nge kuvanda ya kuzenga mpi mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Ivory Coast is a country in West Africa that has been in the midst of a civil war since 2010.
target_text: Cote d'Ivoire kele insi ya Afrique ya ouest yina kele ti bitumba ya bana-bwala banda 2010.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The conflict began after incumbent president Laurent Gbagbo refused to accept defeat in the 2010 presidential election.
target_text: Bitumba yantikaka ntangu prezida Laurent Gbagbo buyakaka kundima kibela na yandi na vote ya prezida na 2010.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Gbagbo was eventually ousted by forces loyal to Alassane Ouattara, who was declared the winner of the election.
target_text: Nsuka-nsuka, basoda ya Alassane Ouattare kulutaka Gbagbo, ebuna bo tubaka nde Ouattare muntu me nunga na bavoti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: However, the conflict has continued, with sporadic violence breaking out in the country.
target_text: Ata mpidina, bitumba me manaka ve; yo ke vutukaka bantangu ya nkaka na insi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In 2017, there were hopes that the country would finally be able to move on from the civil war.
target_text: Na 2017, kivuvu vandaka nde nsuka-nsuka insi ta yambula bitumba ya bana-bwala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: However, these hopes were dashed when Gbagbo was acquitted of charges of crimes against humanity by the International Criminal Court.
target_text: Kansi, bivuvu yai bwaka na masa ntangu tribinale international ya crime katulaka mambu yina bo fundaka Gbagbo nde yandi salaka crime contre l'humanité.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Gbagbo's acquittal was seen as a blow to the peace process, and it led to renewed violence in the country.
target_text: Bantu monaka nde kuyambula mambu ya bo fundilaka Gbagbo bebisaka ngidika ya ngemba, mpi yo basisaka diaka mubulu na insi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In 2018, the United Nations Security Council imposed sanctions on Gbagbo and his supporters.
target_text: Na 2018, Conseil ya Sécurité ya ONU pesaka Gbagbo ti bantu ya ke kotilaka yandi bandola.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The sanctions were aimed at pressuring Gbagbo to end his support for violence in the country.
target_text: Bo pesaka bandola yina sambu na kupusa Gbagbo na kuyambula kupesa maboko na mubulu na insi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The sanctions have had some success, and there has been a decrease in violence in Ivory Coast since they were imposed.
target_text: Bandola yina me nungaka mwa fioti, mpi mubulu me kulumukaka na Cote d'Idoire banda bo me pesaka yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: However, the country is still far from stable.
target_text: Ata mpidina, ngemba me kotaka ntete ve na insi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are many different ways to do laundry, from using a traditional washing machine and dryer to more eco-friendly methods like hand washing and line drying.
target_text: Kele ti mitindu mingi ya kuyobisa bilele, banda na kusadila mashine ya bilele mpi ya kuyumisa yo mpi bametode ya mbote bonso kuyobisa bilele na maboko mpi kuyumisa yo na nsinga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One way to do laundry without using a machine is to hand wash your clothes in a basin or sink.
target_text: Mutindu mosi ya kuyobisa bilele kuzanga kusadila mashine kele kuyobisa bilele na dilonga to na masa ya ke luta.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: To do this, fill the basin with warm water and add a small amount of laundry detergent.
target_text: Sambu na kusala yo, fulusa masa na dilonga mpe yiika mwa ndambu ya nkisi ya kuyobisa bilele.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Soak your clothes for a few minutes, then scrub them with a washcloth or brush.
target_text: Kotika bilele na nge na masa mwa miniti fioti, na nima nika yo ti gant to brosse.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Rinse your clothes thoroughly in clean water, then wring them out.
target_text: Dipa bilele na masa ya bunkete, na nima fina sambu na kubasisa masa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Hang your clothes to dry on a clothesline or drying rack.
target_text: Tanda bilele na nge na kima ya kutandila yo to na kima ya kuyumisa yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Another option is to use a washing machine without a dryer.
target_text: Metode ya nkaka kele kusadila mashine ya kuyobisa bilele kansi ya kuyumisa ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This can save energy and money, but it does require more time and effort.
target_text: Yo lenda sadisa na kubumba energie mpi mbongo, kansi yo ke lombaka ntangu mpi ngolo mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: To wash clothes in a machine without a dryer, fill the machine with water and add laundry detergent.
target_text: Sambu na kuyobisa bilele na mashine kukonda kuyumisa yo, fulusa mashine ti masa mpi tula nkisi ya kuyobisa bilele.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Set the machine to the appropriate cycle, then start it.
target_text: Tula mashine na programe ya me bonga, na nima demarrer.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When the cycle is complete, remove your clothes from the machine and hang them to dry.

source_text: I'm concerned about the environment and the impact that climate change is having on our planet.

source_text: I'm also a big fan of technology and gadgets, so I'm always looking for ways to reduce my carbon footprint without sacrificing my lifestyle.

source_text: That's why I'm so excited about renewable and alternative energy sources.

source_text: Renewable energy is energy that comes from sources that are naturally replenished, such as solar, wind, and water power.

source_text: Alternative energy is energy that comes from sources that are not traditionally used for power generation, such as biomass and geothermal energy.

source_text: Both renewable and alternative energy sources are clean and sustainable, meaning they don't produce greenhouse gases or other pollutants.

source_text: One of the best ways to make a difference is to switch to renewable energy sources for your home.

source_text: You can do this by installing solar panels on your roof, buying a wind turbine, or signing up for a green power plan from your utility company.

source_text: You can also reduce your energy consumption by unplugging appliances when you're not using them, turning off the lights when you leave a room, and using energy-efficient appliances.

source_text: The type of fish you choose will depend on your personal preferences and the intended use for the fish.

source_text: If you are looking for a fish that is high in omega-3 fatty acids, then you may want to choose a wild river fish.

source_text: However, wild river fish can be more expensive and difficult to find.

source_text: If you are looking for a fish that is mild in flavor and easy to cook, then you may want to choose a calm lake fish.

source_text: Calm lake fish are also typically more affordable and easier to find than wild river fish.

source_text: If you are looking for a fish that is low in cost and easy to care for, then you may want to choose a stock pond farm raised variety.

source_text: These fish are typically raised in controlled environments and are fed a diet that is designed to promote growth.

source_text: Ultimately, the best type of fish for you will depend on your individual needs and preferences.

source_text: Do some research to learn more about the different types of fish available and choose the one that is right for you.

source_text: Unsolved mysteries have captured the public's imagination for centuries.

source_text: From the disappearance of Amelia Earhart to the identity of Jack the Ripper, these cases have left us wondering what really happened.

source_text: One of the most famous unsolved mysteries is the disappearance of Amelia Earhart.
