source_text: Despite their fearsome reputation, giant wolf spiders are actually quite docile creatures.
target_text: Ata yo me zabanaka nde yo ke bangisaka, bayuyu ya nene ya ba loup ke vandaka mbala mingi bigangwa ya mawete.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They are not aggressive towards humans unless they are provoked, and their venom is not typically fatal to humans.
target_text: Yo ke nwanisaka ve bantu katula kaka kana nge me sosila yo, mpi ndikila na yo ke fwaka ve bantu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: However, their bite can be quite painful, and can cause swelling, redness, and itching.
target_text: Kansi, kutatika na yo lenda vanda mpasi, mpi yo lenda vimbisa muntu, kukuma mpusi ya nitu mbwaki, mpi kusala mukusa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Giant wolf spiders are excellent climbers, and can use their silk to create webs that can reach up to 30 feet in length.
target_text: Bayuyu ya nene ya ba loup me zaba mbote kumata, mpi lenda sadila soie na yo na kusala banzo ya yuyu yina lenda kuma nda na 30 pieds.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They are also very fast runners, and can move at speeds of up to 10 miles per hour.
target_text: Yo ke bakaka mpi ntinu nswalu, mpi yo lenda sala bamile 10 na ngunga mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Due to their size, speed, and climbing ability, giant wolf spiders are a popular choice for people who want to experience the thrill of riding a giant arachnid.
target_text: Na kutadila nene, ntinu, mpi mayele na yo ya kumata, bayuyu ya nene ya ba loup kele mbisi yina ke zolamaka mingi na bantu yina ke zolaka kuwa kiese ya kuta arachnide ya nene.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: However, it is important to remember that these creatures are wild animals, and should be treated with respect.
target_text: Kansi, yo kele mfunu na kuvila ve nde bigangwa yai kele bambisi ya mfinda, mpi beto fwete sadila yo mambu ti luzitu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If you are thinking about riding a giant wolf spider, it is important to do your research and make sure that you are properly prepared.
target_text: Kana nge kele ti nzala ya kumata na yuyu ya nene ya loup, yo kele mfunu mingi na kusala bansosa mpi na kudibongisa mbote kibeni.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You should also make sure that you have the proper equipment, such as a harness and a leash.
target_text: Nge fwete sala yonso mpi nde nge vanda ti bisadilu ya me fwana, mu mbandu nsinga ya kukanga yo mpi ya kutwadisa yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Once you are properly prepared, you can begin your journey by finding a suitable giant wolf spider.
target_text: Kana nge me kudibongisa mbote, nge lenda yantika voyage na nge na kuzwa yuyu ya nene ya loup.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Once you have found a spider, you can approach it slowly and gently.
target_text: Na nima ya kuzwa yuyu, nge lenda pusana pene-pene na yo na malembe mpi na mawete.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Once the spider is comfortable with you, you can slowly climb onto its back.
target_text: Na nima ya kuyikana ti yuyu, nge lenda mata na malembe na mukongo na yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Once you are on the spider's back, you can hold on tightly and enjoy the ride.
target_text: Ntangu nge me mata na mukongo ya yuyu, nge lenda simba yo ngolo mpi kusepela ti voyage na nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The spider will use its silk to create a web that will support you as you ride.
target_text: Yuyu ta sadila soie na yo na kusala nzo yina ta tanina nge ntangu nge ke tambula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Riding a giant wolf spider is an unforgettable experience.
target_text: Kutambula na yuyu ya nene ya loup kele kima ya nge ta vilaka ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is a great way to experience the thrill of the wild, and to get up close and personal with one of the world's most fascinating creatures.
target_text: Yo kele eskperianse ya kitoko na mfinda, mpi ya kupusana pene-pene ti mosi ya bigangwa ya ke yitukisaka mingi na nsi-ntoto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Fatima Messaoudi: I'm an actor and a furniture designer. I'm also passionate about flowers, especially those that bloom in the winter.
target_text: Fatima Messaoudi: Mono kele ngangi mpi muntu ya ke salaka bima. Mono ke sepelaka mpi ti bintuntu, mingimingi yina ke basikaka na nsungi ya madidi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Interviewer: What drew you to acting and furniture design?
target_text: Muntu ya ke yula bangiufula: Inki pusaka nge na kubaka kussala bansaka mpi ba meuble?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Fatima Messaoudi: I've always loved performing and creating things.
target_text: Fatima Messaoudi: Mono ke zolaka banda ntama kusala bansaka mpi kuganga bima.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Acting allows me to express myself creatively, and furniture design allows me to use my creativity to make something beautiful and functional.
target_text: Kusala bansaka ke sadisaka mono na kubasisa mambu ya mono me zaba, mpi kusala ba meuble ke sadisaka mono na kusadila mayele na mono sambu na kusala bima ya kitoko mpi ya ke sala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Interviewer: What are some of the challenges you've faced as an actor and a furniture designer?
target_text: Muntu ya ke yula bangiufula: Inki kele mwa mambu ya mpasi ya nge me kutanaka ti yo na kisalu ya acteur mpi muntu ya ke salaka bima?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Fatima Messaoudi: One of the challenges I've faced as an actor is the lack of diversity in the industry.
target_text: Fatima Messaoudi: Mpasi mosi ya mono me kutanaka ti yo bonso acteur kele kukonda diversité na kisalu na beto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I've often been told that I'm not the right type for a role because of my race or ethnicity.
target_text: Bo me songaka mono mbala mingi nde mono me fwana ve na kisalu mosi sambu na mpusu ya nitu to dikanda na mono.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: As a furniture designer, I've faced the challenge of breaking into a male-dominated industry.
target_text: Bonso muntu ya ke salala ba meubre, mono me kutanaka ti mpais ya kusala na kisalu yina babakala ke salaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Interviewer: How have you overcome these challenges?
target_text: Muntu ya ke yula bangiufula: Inki mutindu nge me nungaka bampasi yai?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Fatima Messaoudi: I've overcome these challenges by working hard and never giving up.
target_text: Fatima Messaoudi: Mono me nungaka bampasi yai na kusala ngolo mpi na kubwisaka ve maboko.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Translation has many benefits, including increasing the relative value of content, improving accessibility, and opening up new markets.
target_text: Kubalula mambu kele ti mambote mingi, mu mbandu kumatisa valeur ya mambu, kusadisa bantu mingi na kumona yo, mpi kukangula bazandu ya mpa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When content is translated, it becomes accessible to a wider audience, which can lead to increased sales and profits.
target_text: Kana bo me balula mambu, bantu mingi lenda tanga yo, ebuna yo lenda sala nde nge teka bima mingi mpi nge zwa mbongo mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In addition, translation can help to build relationships with customers in other countries and cultures.
target_text: Diaka, kubalula mambu lenda sadisa na kusala kinduku ya bakiliya ya bansi mpi ba culture ya nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: By displaying content in multiple languages, businesses can show that they are committed to reaching a global audience.
target_text: Kana bo ke tula mambu na bo na bandinga mingi, bantu ya mumbongo lenda monisa nde bo me kudipesa na kusadisa bantu ya bansi mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This can help to build trust and credibility with potential customers.
target_text: Yo lenda sadisa na kupusa bakiliya na kutudila beno ntina mpi kundima beno.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Here are some specific examples of how translation has benefited businesses: * A small business that sells handmade jewelry translated its website into Spanish, French, and German.
target_text: Tala mwa bambandu ya kieleka ya mutindu kubalula mambu ke natilaka mumbongo mambote: * Kompani mosi ya fioti yina ke tekaka mayaka ya bo me sala na maboko balulaka site internet na yo na Espagnole, Français mpi Allemand.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: As a result, it saw a significant increase in sales from international customers * A large corporation that manufactures medical devices translated its product manuals into multiple languages.
target_text: Ebuna yo kumaka kuteka bima mingi na bakiliya ya bansi ya nkaka * Kompani mosi ya nene yina ke tekaka bisadilu ya kimunganga balulaka bima na yo na bandingi mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This helped to ensure that doctors and nurses in other countries could use the devices safely and effectively * A nonprofit organization that provides humanitarian aid translated its brochures and websites into dozens of languages.
target_text: Yo sadisaka sambu minganga na ba infirmier ya bansi ya nkaka kusadila ba apareyi na bo na mutindu ya mbote mpi ya me fwana * Kimvuka mosi ya ke salaka ve mumbongo yina ke sadisaka bantu balulaka tumikanda mpi site internet na yo na bandinga mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This helped to reach people in need who would not have otherwise been able to access the organization's resources.
target_text: Yo sadisaka na kuzwa bansukami yina zolaka kuvanda ti mpila ya nkaka ya kuzwa bansangu ya me tala kimvuka yai.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Translation is a powerful tool that can help businesses to grow and succeed.
target_text: Kubalula mikanda kele kisadilu ya mfunu yina lenda sadisa mumbongo na kuyela mpi kununga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This is because we are all created in God's image, and God is the essence of rationality and order.
target_text: Yo kele mpidina sambu beto yonso gangamaka na kifwani ya Nzambi, mpi Nzambi ya ndonga mpi ya kukonda mavwanga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When we live in accordance with our true nature, we are able to experience peace and harmony.
target_text: Kana beto ke zinga na kuwakana ti nature na beto ya kieleka, beto lenda zwa ngemba mpi bumosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: However, when we allow our thoughts and actions to become chaotic and inconsistent, we experience inner conflict and turmoil.
target_text: Kansi, kana beto ke bika nde bangindu mpi bisalu na beto kukuma ya mbi mpi ya mbote ve, beto ta kutana it mavwanga mpi ya kukonda kuwakana.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are many ways to achieve internal consistency.
target_text: Yo kele ti mitindu mingi ya kuvanda ti bukatikati na kati.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One way is to live according to our values.
target_text: Mutindu mosi kele ya kuzingu na kuwakana ti bavaleur na beto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When we know what is important to us and we make choices that are consistent with those values, we feel a sense of purpose and direction.
target_text: Kana beto me zaba nki kele mfunu sambu na beto mpi beto ke sala bansola yina ke wakana ti ba valeur yina, beto ta mona nde beto kele ti lukanu mpi ti lutwadisu ya mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Another way to achieve internal consistency is to be honest with ourselves about our strengths and weaknesses.
target_text: Mutindu ya nkaka ya kuvanda ti bukatikati na kati kele ya kuditubila masonga na yina me tala bisika beto kele ngolo mpi ya beto kele ngolo ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When we are aware of our true selves, we can make choices that are in alignment with our authentic nature.
target_text: Kana beto me kudizaba mbote mpenza, beto lenda sala bansola yina ke wakana ti nature na beto ya kieleka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Of course, achieving internal consistency is not always easy.
target_text: Ya kieleka, kulungisa bukatikati ya kati ke vandaka ve ntangu yonso pete.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There will be times when we make mistakes or when we are faced with difficult choices.
target_text: Bantangu ya nkaka beto ta sala bifu to beto ta kutana ti bansola ya mpasi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: However, if we are willing to strive for consistency, we will eventually find our way back to peace and harmony.
target_text: Kansi, kana beto ke sala ngolo na kusala mambu mutindu mosi, nsukansuka beto ta vutukila ngemba mpi bumosi na beto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Vimes was having a headache.
target_text: Vimes vandaka kuwa ntu mpasi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It was the kind of headache that made you want to tear your hair out, or at least write a strongly worded letter to the makers of whatever it was that had given you the headache in the first place.
target_text: Yo vandaka ntu mpasi yina ke pusa nge na kusosa kutumuna bansuki, to na kusonika mukanda ya nku na bantu yina salaka nde nge bela ntu mpasi na luyantiku.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In this case, the headache was the result of a particularly trying day at work.
target_text: Kana yo kele mpidina, ntu mpasi katukaka na mutindu nge salaka ngolo kilumbu yina na kisalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Vimes had been investigating a series of robberies, and he was starting to feel like he was getting nowhere.
target_text: Vimes vandaka kulandila bima mingi ya bo yibaka, mpi yandi vandaka kudiwa bonso nde yandi ke kwenda ve ata kisika mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He was tired, he was frustrated, and he just wanted to go home and sleep for a week.
target_text: Yandi lembaka, lembaka nitu, mpi vandaka kuzola kaka kukwenda na nzo mpi kulala mposo ya mvimba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: As he was walking back to his office, Vimes passed a small stationery shop.
target_text: Ntangu yandi vandaka kuvutuka na biro na yandi, Vimes lutaka pene-pene ya butiki mosi ya fioti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In the window, he saw a sign that said "Best Letters in the City".
target_text: Na fenetre, yandi monaka kidimbu yina tubaka nde "Bisono ya Kuluta Mbote na Mbanza".
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Vimes stopped and stared at the sign for a moment.
target_text: Vimes atelemaki mpe atalaki elembo wana mwa moke.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He thought about his headache, and he thought about all the letters he had to write.
target_text: Yandi yindulaka ntu-mpasi na yandi, mpi yandi yindulaka mikanda yonso yina yandi sonikaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He sighed and went into the shop.
target_text: Yandi pemaka mpi kwendaka na butiki.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The shop was full of all sorts of stationery supplies.
target_text: Butiki vandaka ya kufuluka ti bima ya kusonikila ya mitindu yonso.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There were pens, pencils, paper, envelopes, stamps, and even a few typewriters.
target_text: Yo vandaka ti babiki, bacrayon, bapapie, ba amvelope, bakashe, mpi nkutu ata mwa bamashine ya kusonikila.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is true that there exist in this world situations that defy all explanation, events so strange and wondrous that they seem to be the stuff of dreams or nightmares.
target_text: Yo kele masonga nde na nsi-ntoto yai yo kele ti mambu yina beto lenda tendula ve, mambu ya kuyituka mpenza yo yina yo monanaka bonso nde yo kele bandosi to bandosi ya mbi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Such is the case with the story I am about to tell you, a tale of supernatural forces and the strange events that unfolded when they were unleashed upon the world.
target_text: Yo kele bonso disolo yai ya mono ke zola ke tela beno, disolo ya bangolo ya kuyituka mpi ya mambu ya kuyituka yina salamaka ntangu bo basisaka bo na nsi-ntoto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It all began one night, when a group of friends were gathered together for a party.
target_text: Mambu yonso yantikaka na mpimpa mosi, ntangu kimvuka mosi ya banduku vukanaka sambu na feti mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They were drinking and laughing, enjoying each other's company, when suddenly the lights went out.
target_text: Bo vandaka kunwa mpi kuseka, mpi kusepela na kinduku na bo, ebuna na mbala mosi bamwinda fwaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The room was plunged into darkness, and the only sound was the sound of their own breathing.
target_text: Kisika yina kumaka mudidi, mpi makelele ya bo vandaka kuwa vandaka kaka kupema na bo mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Then, in the darkness, they saw it: a strange, glowing light.
target_text: Na nima, na kati ya mudidi, bo monaka yo: nsemo ya kuyituka mpi ya ngolo kibeni.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It seemed to be coming from nowhere, and it was growing brighter and brighter.
target_text: Yo ke monana bonso nde yo ke katuka na kisika mosi ve, mpi yo vandaka kaka kukuma ngolo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The friends were terrified, but they were also curious.
target_text: Banduku waka boma ya ngolo, kansi bo vandaka kusosa mpi kuzaba kana yo kele nki.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They wanted to know what this light was, and where it was coming from.
target_text: Bo vandaka kusosa kuzaba kana nsemo yina kele nki, mpi kana yo vandaka kukatuka na wapi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Slowly, they approached the light.
target_text: Malembe-malembe, bo pusanaka pene-pene ya nsemo yina.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: As they got closer, they could see that it was coming from a small, glowing sphere.
target_text: Ntangu bo vandaka kupusana, bo vandaka kumona nde yo ke katuka na kima mosi ya fioti, ya ke sema.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The sphere was hovering in the air, and it was surrounded by a faint aura.
target_text: Kima yango vandaka kutepa-tepa na mupepe, mpi aura ya fioti ziungaka yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Dude, I'm so heartbroken right now. My girlfriend of 2 years just broke up with me."
target_text: "Nduku, mono me fwa kibeni sesepi yai. Dikangu na mono ya beto me sala bamvula 2 me buya mono."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "What happened?"
target_text: "Inki salamaka?"
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "I don't know. She just said she wasn't feeling it anymore.
target_text: "Mono me zaba ve. Yandi tubaka kaka nde yandi ke sepela diaka ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I'm so confused.
target_text: Mono me kuka kisaka-saka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I thought we were happy."
target_text: Mono vandaka kuyindula nde beto kele na kiese."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "I'm sorry, man.I know how you feel. Heartbreak sucks."
target_text: "Mawa nduku. Mono me zaba mpila nge ke kudiwa. Kukabwana ke vandaka mpasi mingi."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "It does. I don't know what to do."
target_text: "Mpidina. Mono ke zaba ve kana mono fwete sala nki."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Just give yourself some time.
target_text: "Kudipwa mwa ntangu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Cry it out if you need to.
target_text: Dila kana yo ke lomba nge sala yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: And then, when you're ready, start to move on.
target_text: Na nima, ntangu nge ta vanda ya kuyilama, banda kukwenda na ntwala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are plenty of other fish in the sea."
target_text: Yo kele ti bankento mingi ya nkaka na nsi-ntoto."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "I know. But I don't know if I'm ready to date again yet."
target_text: "Mono me zaba. Kansi mono me zaba ve kana mono ta kuka diaka kuzola."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "That's okay. You don't have to be ready right away. Just take your time and heal."
target_text: "Yo ke mbote. Yo ke lomba ve nge vanda ya kuyilama kaka sesepi. Baka ntangu mpi beluka."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "Thanks, man. I appreciate it."
target_text: "Matondo, nduku. Me sepela."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: "No problem."
target_text: "Kima ve."
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A: Do you think the dowry system is a good thing?
target_text: A: Nge ke yindula nde kulomba mbongo ya makwela kele kima ya mbote?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: B: I don't think so.
target_text: B: Mono ke ndima ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I think it's a form of discrimination against women.
target_text: Mono ke yindula yo kele mutindu mosi ya kumona bankento nde bo kele ve na mfunu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It puts an unfair financial burden on the bride's family, and it can lead to women being treated as commodities.
target_text: Yo ke pesaka mukumba ya mbongo ya kukonda mfunu na dibuta ya bakala, mpi yo lenda pusa na kutadila bankento bonso bima.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A: But some people say that the dowry system is a way to protect women.
target_text: A: Kansi bantu ya nkaka ke tubaka mbongo ya makwela kele mutindu mosi ya kutanina bankento.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: B: I don't think that's true.
target_text: B: Mono ke ndima yo ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In fact, I think it can put women in danger.
target_text: Na kutuba ya kieleka, mono ke yindula nde yo lenda tula bankento na kigonsa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If a woman's family can't afford to pay a dowry, she may be less likely to be able to find a husband.
target_text: Kana dibuta ya nkento lenda zwa ve mbongo ya makwela, nkento ta vanda ti chance ya fioti ya kuzwa bakala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: And if she does get married, she may be more likely to be abused or mistreated by her husband.
target_text: Mpi kana yandi kwela, chance kele mingi nde bakala na yandi kusadila yandi mambu ya mbi to kuniokula yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A: So what do you think we should do about the dowry system?
target_text: A: Ebuna nge ke yindula nde beto fwete sala inki na ngidika ya mbongo ya makwela?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: B: I think we should work to abolish it.
target_text: B: Mono ke yindula nde beto fwete fwa ngidika yai.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We should educate people about the harmful effects of the dowry system, and we should support laws that make it illegal to demand or accept a dowry.
target_text: Beto fwete longa bantu na yina me tala bupusi ya mbi ya ngidika ya mbongo ya makwela, mpi beto fwete pesa maboko na bansiku yina ke tuba nde nsiku ke buyisa kulomba to kundima mbongo ya makwela.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A: I agree. I think the dowry system is a relic of a bygone era.
target_text: A: Mono me ndima. Mono ke yindula nde ngidika ya mbongo ya makwela kele kima mosi ya nkulu mpenza.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I have been living with type 1 diabetes for over 20 years.
target_text: Mono ke zingaka ti diabete ya mutindu 1 banda bamvula kuluta 20.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I was diagnosed when I was just 10 years old, and it has been a lifelong journey.
target_text: Bo kangaka mono yo ntangu mono vandaka ti bamvula 10, mpi yo kele nzietelo mosi ya luzingu ya mvimba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There have been many challenges along the way, but I have also learned a lot about myself and what it means to be a strong, resilient person.
target_text: Mono me kutanaka ti bampasi mingi, kansi mono me longukaka mpi mambu mingi mono mosi mpi ntendula ya kuvanda muntu ya ngolo, ya ke kangaka ntima.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One of the biggest challenges I have faced is managing my blood sugar levels.
target_text: Mpasi mosi ya kuluta ngolo ya mono me kutanaka ti yo kele kulandila nivo na mono ya sucre.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Diabetes is a condition that affects the way your body turns food into energy.
target_text: Diabete kele maladi yina ke vandaka na bupusi na mutindu nitu na nge ke kumissaka madia energie.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When you eat, your body breaks down the carbohydrates in your food into glucose, which is then absorbed into your bloodstream.
target_text: Ntangu nge ke diaka, nitu na nge ke kumisaka ba glucide yina ke vandaka na madia glucose, na nima yo ke kotaka na kati ya menga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Your pancreas releases insulin, a hormone that helps glucose get from your blood into your cells.
target_text: Pancrea na nge ke basisaka insiline, hormone mosi yina ke sadisaka glucose na kulutisa menga na baselile.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In people with type 1 diabetes, the pancreas doesn't make enough insulin, or it doesn't make any at all.
target_text: Na bantu yina ke vandaka ti diabete ya mutindu 1, pancrea ke basisaka ve insiline mingi, to yo ke basisaka yo ve ata fioti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This means that people with type 1 diabetes have to take insulin injections to help their bodies use glucose for energy.
target_text: Yo ke tendula nde bantu yina kele ti diabete ya mutindu 1 fwete baka bantunga ya insiline sambu yo sadisa nitu na bo na kusadila glucose bonso kisina ya energie.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Managing my blood sugar levels can be a tricky business.
target_text: Kulandila nivo ya sucre na mono lenda vanda kisalu ya mpasi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are a lot of factors that can affect my blood sugar, including what I eat, how much I exercise, and how much stress I am under.
target_text: Kele ti bima mingi yina lenda vanda ti bupusi na nivo ya sucre, ata mpi madia ya mono ke diaka, ngalasisi ya mono ke salaka, mpi basusi yina mono kele ti yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I have to constantly monitor my blood sugar levels and make adjustments to my insulin doses as needed.
target_text: Mono fwete landila ntangu yonso nivo na mono ya sucre mpi kusala bansoba na badose na mono ya insiline kana yo me fwana.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The flavors dance on your tongue, creating a symphony of delight.
target_text: Ntomo ke kinaka na ludimi na nge, yo ke salaka elengi ya kuyituka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The pineapple is sweet and tart, the apple is crisp and juicy, the stone fruit is juicy and flavorful, and the pear is sweet and refreshing.
target_text: Ananasi ke vandaka ti sukadi mpi acide, pomme ke vandaka ti musuni mpi masa mingi, mbuma ya ditadi ke vandaka ti masa mingi mpi kitoko, mpe poire ke vandaka ntomo mpi ke bwisaka ntima.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The flavors are perfectly balanced, and each one complements the others.
target_text: Bantoma kele ya kuyidika mbote, konso kima ke wakanaka mbote ti ya nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The combination is simply irresistible.
target_text: Combinaison yina kele kitoko mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You can enjoy this delicious fruit salad on its own, or as a topping for yogurt or ice cream.
target_text: Nge lenda dia salade yai ya bambuma ya kitoko yo mosi, to kutula yo na zulu ya yaourt to ya creme ya madidi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is also a great addition to a summer picnic or potluck.
target_text: Yo kele madia ya kitoko sambu na pique-nique to sambu na madia ya nsungi ya ntangu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: No matter how you enjoy it, you are sure to love this fruit salad.
target_text: Ata nge ke dia yo nki mutindu, nge ta sepela ti salade yai ya mbuma.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A: Did you know that deforestation is one of the leading causes of climate change?
target_text: A: Keti nge me zaba nde kufwa bamfinda kele mosi ya bikuma ya ke sala nde klima kusoba?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: B: No, I didn't.
target_text: B: Ve, me zaba ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: How does that work?
target_text: Inki ke salaka inki mutindu?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A: Well, when we cut down trees, we're not just destroying the trees themselves.
target_text: A: Bon, ntangu beto ke zengaka banti, beto ke zengaka ve kaka banti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We're also destroying the habitats of countless animals and plants.
target_text: Beto ke bebisaka mpi kisika ya kuzinga ya bambisi mpi banti mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: And when we lose these habitats, we also lose the benefits that they provide us.
target_text: Mpi ntangu beto ke vandaka diaka ve ti bisika yai, beto ke vidisaka mpi mambote yina yo ke pesaka beto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: B: Like what?
target_text: B: Bonso nki?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A: Well, for example, trees help to regulate the climate.
target_text: A: Mu mbandu, banti ke sadisaka na kubongisa klima.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They absorb carbon dioxide from the air and release oxygen.
target_text: Yo ke bendaka dioxyde ya carbone na mupepe mpi yo ke basisaka oxygene.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They also help to prevent soil erosion and flooding.
target_text: Yo ke sadisaka mpi ntoto sambu yo pasuka ve mpi sambu masa kufuluka ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: And they provide food and shelter for animals.
target_text: Yo ke pesaka bambisi madia mpi kisika ya kuzinga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: B: So deforestation has a lot of negative effects.
target_text: B: Kufwa bamfinda kele ti bupusi mingi ya mbi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A: It does.
target_text: A: Mpidina.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: And it's a problem that's only getting worse.
target_text: Yo diambu yai ke landa kaka kubeba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Every year, we lose millions of acres of forest to deforestation.
target_text: Konso mvula, beto ke vidisaka bamilio ya bakilometre ya bamfinda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: And if we don't do something to stop it, the consequences will be devastating.
target_text: Mpi kana beto sala kima ve sambu na kukanga yo nzila, malanda na yo ta vanda mbi kibeni.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: B: What can we do to stop it?
target_text: B: Inki beto lenda sala sambu na kukanga yo?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A: There are a number of things we can do.
target_text: A: Kele ti mambu mingi yina beto lenda sala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We can reduce our demand for wood products.
target_text: Beto lenda kumisa bima ya mabaya to banti ya beto ke sadilaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We can plant trees.
target_text: Beto lenda kuna banti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I was fortunate to attend a school that offered a wide range of AP courses and extracurricular activities, which gave me the opportunity to explore my interests and learn about different career paths.
target_text: Mono vandaka ti dibaku ya mbote ya kukota na ekole yina vandaka ti malongi mingi ya AP mpi bisalu ya nima ya nzo-nkanda; yo sadisaka mono na kutadila bima yina mono ke zolaka mpi na kulonguka bisalu ya kuswaswana.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One of the most important things I learned in high school was how to think critically and solve problems.
target_text: Mosi ya mambu ya mfunu mingi yina mono longukaka na humanité vandaka mpila ya kuyindula na mutindu ya kutula ntembe mpi kuyidika mambu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: My AP English and math classes taught me how to analyze text and data, and my science classes taught me how to design and conduct experiments.
target_text: Malongi ya Anglais mpi ya matematike ya nivo ya zulu longaka mono mutindu ya kutadila bisono mpi bansangu, mpi malongi ya siansi longukaka mono mutindu ya kusala ba eksperiansi mpi kubongisa yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These skills have been essential in my college courses and my career as a software engineer.
target_text: Mayele yai kele mfunu mingi na malongi na mono ya iniversite mpi na kisalu na mono bonso enzeniere ya ba logiciel.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Another important thing I learned in high school was how to work effectively with others.
target_text: Kima ya nkaka ya mfunu ya mono longukaka na humanité vandaka mutindu ya kusala mbote ti bantu ya nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: My participation in extracurricular activities such as student government and the debate team taught me how to communicate my ideas clearly and persuasively, and how to work as part of a team to achieve a common goal.
target_text: Kuvukana na bisalu ya nima ya nzo-nkanda mu mbandu luyalu ya bana ya nzo-nkanda mpi ekipe ya debat me longaka mono mutindu ya kubasisa bangindu pwelele mpi na mpila ya ke ndimisa, mpi mutindu ya kusala na ekipe sambu na kulungisa lukanu mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These skills have been invaluable in my career, where I often have to collaborate with others to solve complex problems.
target_text: Mayele yai kele mfunu mingi na kisalu na mono, sambu mbala mingi mono ke salaka ti bantu ya nkaka sambu na kuyidika mambu ya mpasi mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Finally, my high school experience helped me to develop a strong work ethic and a commitment to excellence.
target_text: Na nsuka, eksperianse na mono ya humanité sadisaka mono na kuyedisa bikalulu ya mbote ya kisalu mpi na kudipesa na kusala kisalu mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The challenging academic courses I took taught me the importance of hard work and perseverance, and the extracurricular activities I participated in taught me the value of teamwork and dedication.
target_text: Malongi ya ngolo ya iniversite ya mono longukaka longaka mono mfunu ya kusala ngolo mpi ya kukwamina, mpi bisalu ya nima ya nzo-nkanda yina mono salaka me longaka mono mfunu ya kusala na kimvuka mpi ya kudipesa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These qualities have helped me to succeed in college and in my career.
target_text: Bikalulu yai me sadisaka mono na kununga na iniversite mpi na kisalu na mono.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I am grateful for the opportunity to have attended a high school that provided me with such a strong educational foundation.
target_text: Mono ke pesa ntonda sambu na dibaku ya mono zwaka ya kukota na nzo-nkanda ya humanité mpi yo pesaka mono fondation ya ngolo ya nzo-nkanda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I believe that the skills and knowledge I gained in high school have helped me to become a successful college student and a professional.
target_text: Mono ke yindula nde mayele mpi nzayilu ya mono longukaka na humanité me sadisaka mono na kukuma mwana ya nzo-nkanda ya iniversité mpi muntu ya kisalu ya me nunga.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Pottery is a craft that involves making objects out of clay.
target_text: Kuwumba kele kisalu yina ke lombaka kusala bima na ntoto ya tuma.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Pottery is often used for utilitarian purposes, such as storing food or water, but it can also be used for decorative purposes.
target_text: Kuwumba ke sadilamaka mbala mingi sambu na mambu ya mfunu, mu mbandu kubumba madia to masa, kansi bo lenda sadila yo mpi sambu na kukumisa nzo to kisika kitoko.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The process of making pottery begins with gathering clay.
target_text: Kisalu ya kuwumba ke yantikaka na kubaka ntoto ya tuma.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Clay is a natural material that is found in the ground.
target_text: Ntoto ya tuma kele kima ya lugangu ya bo ke vandaka na ntoto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Once the clay has been gathered, it is mixed with water and kneaded until it is soft and pliable.
target_text: Na nima ya kubaka ntoto ya tuma, bo ke vukisaka yo ti masa mpi kuvukisa yo tii kuna yo ta kuma pete-pete mpenza.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The potter then uses a variety of tools to shape the clay into the desired form.
target_text: Na nima, muwumbi ke sadialaka bisadilu mingi sambu na kupesa ntoto ya tuma forme yina yandi me zola.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Once the clay is shaped, it is dried and fired in a kiln.
target_text: Na nima ya kupesa ntoto ya tuma forme, yo ke yumisaka mpi ke yokaka yo na four.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Rainstorms are a common occurrence in many parts of the world, and they can have a significant impact on our lives.
target_text: Mipepe ya ngolo ke bulaka na bisika mingi na nsi-ntoto, mpi yo lenda vanda ti bupusi ya ngolo na luzingu na beto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They can bring much-needed water to parched land, but they can also cause flooding, mudslides, and other damage.
target_text: Yo ke nataka masa na bisika ya kuyuma, kansi yo lenda fulusa masa mpi kunata poto-poto mpi bampasi ya nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Rainstorms are caused by the rising of warm air, which causes water vapor to condense and form clouds.
target_text: Mipepe ya ngolo ke katukaka na kumata ya mupepe ya tiya na zulu, ebuna yo ke salaka nde mupepe ya masa kukangama mpi kusala matuti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When the water droplets in the clouds become too heavy, they fall as rain.
target_text: Ntangu matonsi ya masa yina kele na matuti ke kumaka kilo mingi, yo nokaka bonso mvula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The amount of rain that falls in a rainstorm is measured in inches.
target_text: Bo ke tesaka mingi ya mvula yina ke nokaka na mipepe ya ngolo na basantimetre.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A light rainstorm might produce only a few inches of rain, while a heavy rainstorm can produce over a foot of rain.
target_text: Mipepe ya ngolo ya fioti lenda basisa kaka mwa basantimetre ya mvula, kansi mipepe ya ngolo mingi lenda basisa basantimetre 30 ya mvula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Rainstorms can have a variety of effects on our lives.
target_text: Mipepe ya ngolo lenda vanda ti bupusi ya mutindu na mutindu na luzingu na beto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They can wash away dirt and debris, making roads and sidewalks impassable.
target_text: Yo lenda nata salete mpi mvindu, ebuna yo kanga banzila mpi bisika ya kulutila.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They can also cause power outages and flooding.
target_text: Yo lenda zenga courant mpi kusala nde masa kufuluka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Flooding can be especially dangerous, as it can quickly sweep away people and property.
target_text: Kufuluka ya masa lenda vanda kigonsa ya nene, sambu yo lenda nata ntinu bantu mpi bima.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Despite the potential dangers, rainstorms can also be beneficial.
target_text: Ata bigonsa kele, mipepe ya ngolo lenda vanda ti mambote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They can help to improve soil quality and water the plants.
target_text: Yo lenda sadisa na kubongisa qualité ya ntoto mpi kulosila banti masa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Rainstorms can also be a source of entertainment, as people enjoy watching the rain and listening to the thunder.
target_text: Mipepe ya ngolo lenda sadisa mpi na kuyangidika bantu, sambu bantu ke sepelaka kutala mvula mpi kuwa makelele ya nzasi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Eyes are complex organs that allow us to see.
target_text: Meso kele kinama ya mindondo yina ke sadisaka beto na kumona.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They are located in the front of the head and are protected by the eyelids.
target_text: Yo ke vandaka na ntwala ya ntu na beto mpi yo ke taninamaka na mansala ya meso.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Each eye is made up of three layers: the sclera, the choroid, and the retina.
target_text: Konso disu ke vandaka ti bitini tatu: sclera, choroide, mpi retine.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The sclera is the white part of the eye, the choroid is the dark layer behind the sclera, and the retina is the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.
target_text: Sclera kele kitini ya mpembe ya disu, choroide kele kitini ya ndombe yina kele na nima ya sclera, mpi retine kele couche ya sensible na nsemo yina ke vandaka na nima ya meso.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The retina contains millions of light-sensitive cells called rods and cones.
target_text: Retine ke vandaka ti bamilio ya baselile oyo ke zabaka nsemo; bo ke bingaka yo barode mpi bacone.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Rods are responsible for night vision, while cones are responsible for color vision.
target_text: Barode kele ti mukumba ya kumona na mpimpa, kansi bacone kele ti mukumba ya kumona mikubu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When light hits the retina, it is converted into electrical signals that are sent to the brain via the optic nerve.
target_text: Ntangu nsemo ke kumaka na retine, yo ke kumisaka yo bidimbu ya courant yina ke tindamaka na butomfu na nzila ya musisa ya optique.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: My family has always kept animals.
target_text: Dibuta na mono ke vandaka ntangu yonso ti bambisi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When I was a child, we had a dog, a cat, and a few fish.
target_text: Ntangu mono vandaka mwana, beto vandaka ti mbwa, nyawu, mpi mwa bambisi ya masa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: As I got older, we added a few more animals to the mix, including a rabbit, a guinea pig, and a hamster.
target_text: Ntangu mono kumaka mbuta, beto yikaka bambisi ya nkaka sambu na kuvukisa, mu mbandu lapin, cobaye, hamster.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I loved taking care of all of our animals and learning about their different needs.
target_text: Mono vandaka kuzola kukeba bambisi na beto nyonso mpi kulonguka bampusa na bo ya kuswaswana.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One of my favorite animals that we ever kept was a rabbit named Cocoa.
target_text: Mbisi mosi ya mono ke zolaka mingi yina beto vandaka ti yo vandaka lapin; zina na yo Cocoa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Cocoa was a brown and white Holland Lop rabbit.
target_text: Cocoa vandaka lapin ya kitoko ya hollande ya brun mpi ya mpembe.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She was the sweetest animal I've ever met and she loved to be cuddled.
target_text: Yo vandaka mbisi ya mawete kuluta yina mono me kutanaka ntete ve ti yo mpi yo vandaka kuzola nde bo yamba yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She was also very smart and could learn tricks like sit, stay, and come.
target_text: Yo vandaka mpi mayele mingi mpi yo vandaka kulonguka mambu bonso vanda, kunikana ve, mpi kwisa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One day, I was playing with Cocoa in the backyard when I noticed that she was chewing on something.
target_text: Kilumbu mosi, mono vandaka kusakana ti Cocoa na kibansala ntangu mono nde yo vandaka kutafuna kima mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I went over to investigate and saw that she was chewing on a piece of fiber from one of our clothes.

source_text: New Study Finds That Breast Cancer Screenings Can Lead to False Positives

notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A new study published in the journal JAMA Internal Medicine has found that breast cancer screenings can lead to false positives.
target_text: Nsosa ya mpa yina bo basisaka na zulunalu JAMA Internal Medicine me mona nde depistage ya kansere ya mabele lenda basisa ba resultat yina kele ve ya masonga.

source_text: The study, which was conducted by researchers at the University of California, San Francisco, found that one in five women who underwent a mammogram had a false positive result.
target_text: Nsosa yango, yina salamaka na bantu ya ke salaka bansosa ya Iniversite ya Californie, na Sana Francisco, monaka nde nkento mosi na kati ya bankento tanu yina bo salaka yandi ekzame ya mabele vandaka ti resultat ya masonga ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: A false positive result is when a mammogram shows that a woman has breast cancer, when she actually does not.
target_text: Resultat ya masonga ve kele ntangu ekzame ya mabele me monisa nde nkento kele ti kansere ya mabele, kansi na kutuba ya masonga yandi kele ve ti yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This can lead to unnecessary anxiety and stress, as well as unnecessary medical procedures, such as biopsies.
target_text: Yo lenda basisa basusi mpi kudiyangisa ya kukonda mfunu, mpi lusansu ya munganga ya kukonda mfunu, mu mbandu ba biopsie.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The study found that the rate of false positives was higher among women who were younger, had dense breasts, and had a family history of breast cancer.
target_text: Nsosa yina monaka nde ntalu ya ba resultat ya masonga ve vandaka na bankento yina vandaka baleke, ti mabele ya nene, mpi ti bantu ya dibuta yina me belaka kansere.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The researchers say that these findings are important because they highlight the need for women to understand the risks and benefits of breast cancer screening before they decide whether or not to undergo a mammogram.
target_text: Bantu ya ke salaka bansosa tubaka nde mambu ya bo monaka kele mfunu sambu yo ke monisa nde bankento fwete zaba bigonsa mpi mambote ya ekzame ya kansere ya mabele na ntwala nde bo baka lukanu ya kusala ekzame yango to ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The study also found that the use of sound waves, known as ultrasound, to screen for breast cancer can help to reduce the number of false positives.

source_text: Ultrasound is a safe and non-invasive imaging technique that can be used to identify abnormalities in the breast.
