source_text: The SMA says that it will continue to investigate the matter and that it will take further action if necessary.
target_text: SMA ke tuba nde yo ta landa kulandila diambu yai mpi nde yo ta baka balukanu ya nkaka kana yo kele mfunu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The Libyan Civil War is an ongoing armed conflict in Libya that began in 2011 with the overthrow of Muammar Gaddafi's government.
target_text: Bitumba ya Bana-Bwala ya Libye kele mvita ya ke mana ve na Libye; yo bandaka na 2011 ntangu bo bwisaka luyalu ya Muammar Gaddafi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: After the fall of Tripoli, the Libyan National Transitional Council (NTC) proclaimed the establishment of the Libyan Interim Government, but the country descended into a state of lawlessness with two rival governments, the NTC and the Libyan National Army (LNA), and a number of militias vying for power.
target_text: Na nima ya kubwa ya Tripoli, Conseil ya Transition ya Libye (NTC) tubaka nde yo me sala Luyalu ya Ntangu fioti ya Libye, kansi konso muntu na insi kumaka kusala mambu mpila yandi me zola mpi bo vandaka ti baluyalu zole ya ke wakana ve, NTC mpi Kimvuka ya Basoda ya Libye (LNA), mpi bimvuka mingi ya basoda vandaka kuzola kubaka kimfumu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In 2014, the Libyan House of Representatives (HoR) was elected in the eastern city of Tobruk, but the HoR has been unable to exercise effective control over the country.
target_text: Na 2014, bo votaka Chambre ya Mimonisi ya Libye (HoR) na mbanza Tobrouk na este, kansi HoR ke kuka ve kusadila kiyeka na yo mbote-mbote na insi ya mvimba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In 2016, the Government of National Accord (GNA) was formed in Tripoli under the auspices of the United Nations, but the GNA has been unable to gain control of the country's eastern regions.
target_text: Na 2016, bo salaka Luyalu ya Kuwakana ya Insi ya Mvimba (GNA) na Tripoli na nsi ya lutwadisu ya Nations-Unies, kansi GNA ke kuka ve kusadila kiyeka na yo babwala ya este ya insi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The LNA, led by Khalifa Haftar, has been fighting against the GNA and its allies in the west of the country.
target_text: LNA, yina ke twadisama na Khalifa Haftar, ke nwanisaka GNA mpi banduku na bo na weste ya insi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The conflict has led to a humanitarian crisis, with hundreds of thousands of people displaced from their homes.
target_text: Kukonda kuwakana yai me kotisaka kinsukami, yo me salaka nde bantu mingi kutina banzo na bo mpi kukwenda kuzinga bisika ya nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The United Nations has called for an immediate ceasefire and the start of a political dialogue.
target_text: Nations-Unies me lombaka bo na kuyambula kunwana mpi na kuyantika masolo ya kuwakana na mambu ya politiki.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The soap opera centers around the lives of the residents of a small town.
target_text: Ka filme yango ke tubila luzingu ya konso kilumbu ya bantu ya ka bwala mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The main character, Constance, is a young woman who is struggling to come to terms with the recent death of her husband.
target_text: Muntu ya nene, Constance, kele leke mosi ya nkento yina ke kuka ve kununga lufwa ya bakala na yandi yina me salama ntama mingi ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She is left to raise her two young children on her own, and she is struggling to find a way to handle her grief.
target_text: Yandi me kuma kusansa bana na yandi zole ya baleke yandi mosi, mpi yandi ke kuka ve kununga mawa na yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One day, Constance meets a man named Frederick at the grocery store.
target_text: Kilumbu mosi, Constance me kutana ti bakala mosi, zina na yandi Frederick, na magasin ya bima ya kudia.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Frederick is a kind and compassionate man, and he offers Constance his support.
target_text: Frederick kele muntu ya mawete mpi mawa, mpi yandi me ndima kusadisa Constance.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Constance begins to develop feelings for Frederick, but she is hesitant to start a new relationship because she is still grieving the loss of her husband.
target_text: Constance me yantika kuzola Frederick, kansi yandi kele ti badute na kuyantika kinduku ya mpa sambu yandi kele ntete ti mpasi ya lufwa ya bakala na yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Eventually, Constance decides to give Frederick a chance.
target_text: Nsuka-nsuka, Constance me baka lukanu ya kupesa Frederick chance.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She starts dating him, and she quickly falls in love with him.
target_text: Yandi me sala kinduku ya makwela ti yandi, mpi yandi me zola mwana-bakala yina nswalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Frederick helps Constance to heal from her grief, and he gives her the strength to raise her children on her own.
target_text: Frederick ke sadisa Constance na kubeluka na mpasi na yandi, mpi ke pesa yandi kikesa ya kusansa bana na yandi, yandi mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Constance and Frederick get married, and they have a happy life together.
target_text: Constance ti Frederick me kwelana, mpi bo zole kele ti luzingu ya kiese.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They raise their children together, and they support each other through good times and bad.
target_text: Bo ke sansa bana na bo na kimvuka, mpi bo ke sadisana na bantngu ya mbote mpi ya mbi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Constance is grateful for Frederick's love and support, and she knows that she will never be able to thank him enough for everything he has done for her.
target_text: Constance kele na ntonda sambu na zola mpi lusadisu ya Frederick, mpi yandi me zaba nde yandi ta kuka ve kupesa yandi mersi mingi kuluta sambu na yonso yina Frederick me sala sambu na yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The soap opera ends with a message of hope.
target_text: Ka filme yina me suka ti nsangu ya kivuvu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: As the twentieth century drew to a close, computers and electronics were becoming increasingly intertwined.
target_text: Mutindu mvu-nkama ya makumi zole ke kuma na nsuka, baordinatere ti bima ya electronike ke kuma ti kuwakana ya ngolo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In the early days of computing, these two fields were largely separate.
target_text: Na luyantiku ya informatique, mambu zole yai vandaka ya kukabwana mpenza.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Computers were large, expensive machines that were used for scientific and military purposes.
target_text: Baordinatere vandaka bamashine ya nene mpi ya ntalu mingi yina bo vandaka kusadila sambu na mambu ya siansi mpi ya basoda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Electronics were used in a variety of consumer products, such as radios, televisions, and telephones.
target_text: Bo vandaka kusadila electronike sambu na bima mingi ya bantu ke sadilaka mu mbandu baradio, batelevizio mpi batelefone.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: However, as computers became smaller and more affordable, they began to be used in a wider variety of applications.
target_text: Kansi, ntangu baordinatere kumaka fioti mpi ti ntalu fioti, bo yantikaka kusadila yo na bima mingi kibeni.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This led to a blurring of the lines between computers and electronics.
target_text: Yo salaka nde yo kuma mpasi na kuzaba luswaswanu na kati ya baordinatere mpi electronike.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One of the most significant developments in the history of computers and electronics was the invention of the personal computer (PC).
target_text: Kima mosi ya mfunu mingi yina bo salaka na disolo ya baordinatere mpi electronike kele kusadila ordinatere ya maboko (PC).
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The PC was first introduced in the 1970s, and it quickly became a popular tool for both personal and business use.
target_text: Bo yantikaka kusadila PC na mbala ya ntete na bamvu 1970, mpi yo kumaka nswalu kisadilu yina muntu yandi mosi mpi mimbongo ke sadila.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: PCs were originally designed for use in homes and offices, but they soon found their way into other settings, such as schools and libraries.
target_text: Na luyantiku, bo salaka PC sambu na kusadila yo na banzo mpi na babiro, kansi ntangu mingi ve bo kumaka kusadila yo na bisika ya nkaka, mu mbandu na banzo-nkanda mpi babiblioteke.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The PC's portability and versatility made it an ideal tool for a wide range of tasks, from word processing to gaming.
target_text: Sambu bo lenda nata PC mpi kusadila yo na mambu mingi salaka nde yo vanda kisadilu ya me fwana sambu na bisalu mingi, banda na kulandila bisono tii na bansaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The development of the PC also led to the development of a new industry: the software industry.
target_text: Kubasika ya PC me sadisaka na kubasika kisalu ya mpa: kisalu ya kusala ba logiciel.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Software companies created programs that could run on PCs, and these programs quickly became essential tools for PC users.
target_text: Bakompani ya ke salaka ba logiciel salaka baprograme yina bo lenda sala na ba PC, mpi baprograme yai kumaka nswalu bisadilu ya mfunu sambu na bantu ya ke sadilaka ba PC.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The satisfaction of a perfect touch was something that Aida had never experienced before.
target_text: Kiese ya kusimba ya kitoko kibeni kele kima yina Aida me kutanaka ntete ve ti yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She had been with many men, but none of them had ever been able to give her the kind of pleasure that she craved.
target_text: Yandi me vandaka deaja ti babakala mingi, kansi mosi ve na kati na bo me kukaka kupesa yandi kiese yina yandi ke zola.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She had often wondered if she was simply too demanding, or if she was just meant to be alone.
target_text: Yandi vandaka kudiyula mbala mingi kana yandi vandaka kulomba mambu mingi, to kana yo ke lomba kaka nde yandi vanda yandi mosi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: But then she met Hakim.
target_text: Kansi na nima yandi kutanaka ti Hakim.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Hakim was different from any man she had ever met before.
target_text: Hakim swaswanaka ti babakala yonso yina yandi me kutanaka deja ti bo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He was kind, gentle, and he seemed to understand her in a way that no one else ever had.
target_text: Yandi vandaka mawete, ntima-mbote mpi yo ke monana nde yandi vandaka kubakisa Aida na mutindu yina muntu mosi ve me bakisaka yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He took his time with her, exploring her body with a tenderness that made her melt.
target_text: Hakim bakaka ntnagu na yandi, yandi simbaka nitu ya Aida na mawete ebuna Aida kudiwaka bonso nde yandi me kuma masa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: And when he finally touched her in that special way, she felt a wave of pleasure wash over her that was unlike anything she had ever felt before.
target_text: Mpi ntangu nsuka-nsuka yandi simbaka Aida na mutindu ya speciale, Aida waka kiese ya mingi na nitu na yandi, kiese yina me fwanana ve ata ti kima mosi yina yandi me waka ntete.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It was as if her body had been waiting for his touch all along.
target_text: Yo vandaka bonso nde nitu na yandi vandaka kuvingila kusimba yina banda ntama mpenza.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She felt complete, whole, and for the first time in her life, she knew what it was to be truly satisfied.
target_text: Yandi kudiwaka ya kukuka, mbote mpenza, mpi na mbala ya ntete na luzingu na yandi, yandi zabaka mutindu kiese ya kieleka ke vandaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: As Hakim continued to touch her, she felt herself losing control.
target_text: Ntangu Hakim landaka kusimba yandi, yandi vandaka kukuka diaka ve kudiyala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Her body was on fire, and she could feel the tension building inside of her.
target_text: Nitu na yandi vandaka tiya, mpi yandi vandaka kuwa tension ke mata na ntima na yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: She knew that she was about to come, and she wanted it more than anything she had ever wanted before.
target_text: Yandi zabaka nde yandi zolaka kukwisa, mpi yandi vandaka kuzola yo mingi kuluta konso kima yina yandi me zolaka ntete.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The hajj is a once-in-a-lifetime pilgrimage to Mecca, Saudi Arabia, that is required of all Muslims who are physically and financially able to make the journey.
target_text: Hajj kele voyage na Mecque, na Arabie Saoudite, yina bo ke salaka mbala mosi mpamba na luzingu, yina bo ke lombaka Bamizilma nyonso ya kele ti santé ya mbote mpi ti mbongo ya me fwana na kusala yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The pilgrimage is one of the five pillars of Islam, and it is considered to be the most important spiritual journey a Muslim can make.
target_text: Voyage yai kele mosi ya mambu ya mfunu ya dibundu ya Bamizilma, mpi bo ke tadilaka yo bonso voyage ya mfunu mingi ya kimpeve muntu ya Mizilma lenda sala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The hajj takes place over five days in the Islamic month of Dhu al-Hijjah.
target_text: Hajj ke salamaka na bilumbu tanu na ngonga ya Dhu al-Hijjah ya Bamizilma.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: During the hajj, pilgrims perform a series of rituals that commemorate the life of Prophet Muhammad and the prophets who came before him.
target_text: Na ntangu ya hajj, bantu yina salaka voyage ke salaka binkulu mingi yina yibusaka luzingu ya Profete Mahomet mpi baprofete yina zingaka na ntwala na yandi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These rituals include walking around the Kaaba, the sacred black stone that is the center of the Great Mosque in Mecca; drinking from the Zamzam Well, which is believed to have healing powers; and standing on Mount Arafat, where Prophet Muhammad gave his final sermon.
target_text: Binkulu yango kele kutambula na nziunga ya Kaaba, ditadi ya ndombe ya santu yina kele na kati-kati ya Mosque ya Nene ya Mecque; kunwa masa na Dibulu ya Zamzam, yina bo ke yindulaka nde yo kele ti ngolo ya kubelula; mpi kutelama na Ngumba Arafat, kisika Profete Mahomet salaka disolo na yandi ya nsuka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The hajj is a physically and emotionally demanding journey, but it is also a time for Muslims to come together in worship and to reflect on their lives.
target_text: Hajj voyage ke lombaka ngolo mingi ya nitu mpi mawi, kansi yo kele ntangu yina Bamizilma ke vukanaka sambu na kusambila mpi kuyindula luzingu na bo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is a chance to renew their faith and to reaffirm their commitment to Islam.
target_text: Yo kele dibaku ya kukumisa lukwikilu na bo ya mpa mpi ya kundimisa kudipesa na bo na dibundu ya Bamizilma.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: For many Muslims, the hajj is a life-changing experience.
target_text: Sambu na Bamizilma mingi, hajj kele eksperianse ya ke sobaka luzingu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is a time to leave behind the stresses of everyday life and to focus on their spiritual journey.
target_text: Yo kele ntangu ya kuvila basusi ya luzingu ya konso kilumbu mpi ya kutula dikebi na voyage na bo ya kimpeve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Freedom of the press is the freedom of communication and expression through mediums including printed media and the internet.
target_text: Kimpwanza ya presse kele kimpwanza ya kusolula mpi kutuba na nzila ya bamedia, ata mpi ya kusonika mpi na nzila ya internet.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is a fundamental human right recognized by Article 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and reaffirmed in Article 19 of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights.
target_text: Yo kele nswa ya mfunu ya bantu yina artikle 19 ya Declaration Universelle ya Banswa ya Bantu ke ndimaka mpi yo me ndimisa yo na Artikle 19 ya Kuwakana ya Bansi mingi ya Banswa ya Basivile mpi ya Politiki.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The right to freedom of expression is recognized as a necessary precondition for the enjoyment of all other human rights.
target_text: Nswa ya kimpwanza ya kutuba me ndimamaka bonso condition ya ntete ya mfunu sambu na kuvanda ti banswa yonso ya nkaka ya bantu ke vandaka ti yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Freedom of the press is essential for a healthy democracy.
target_text: Kimpwanza ya presse kele mfunu mingi sambu na demokrasi ya mbote.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It allows citizens to access information and to hold their government accountable.
target_text: Yo ke pesaka bana-bwala nzila ya kuzwa bansangu mpi kupesa luyalu na bo mukumba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It also helps to ensure that all voices are heard, and that the public is informed about important issues.
target_text: Yo ke sadisaka mpi sambu bo wa bangindu ya bantu yonso, mpi sambu bo zabisa bantu yonso makambu ya mfunu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In recent years, there have been growing threats to freedom of the press around the world.
target_text: Na bamvula ya me katuka kuluta, yo vandaka ti mambu mingi yina tulaka na kigonsa kimpwanza ya kutuba na ntoto ya mvimba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Governments have been using laws to restrict the media, and journalists have been harassed and attacked.
target_text: Baluyalu basisaka bansiku sambu na kutula bandilu na bamedia, mpi bo niokulaka mpi me nwanisaka bapanzi-nsangu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These threats are a serious concern, and they need to be addressed.
target_text: Bigonsa yai kele mutungisi ya nene, mpi yo ke lomba kumanisa yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We must all stand up for freedom of the press.
target_text: Beto yonso fwete telama sambu na kimpwanza ya presse.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We must defend the right of journalists to report the news without fear of reprisal.
target_text: Beto fwete nwanisa nswa ya bapanzi-nsangu ya kupesa bansangu kukonda kuwa boma nde bo ta pesa bo ndola.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We must also support independent media outlets, and we must encourage people to read and share news from a variety of sources.
target_text: Beto fwete pesa mpi maboko na bimwangi-nsangu ya ke salaka bo mosi, mpi beto fwete siamisa bantu na kutanga mpi kupanza bansangu na banzila ya kuswaswana.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Freedom of the press is a precious right.
target_text: Kimpwanza ya presse kele nswa ya mfunu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We must all do our part to protect it.
target_text: Beto yonso fwete sala ngolo sambu na kutanina yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The rising temperatures and changing precipitation patterns are making it more difficult to grow crops in some areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.
target_text: Kumata ya tiya mpi nsoba ya mutindu mvula ke noka ke sala nde yo kuma mpasi na kuyedisa bimenina na bisika ya nkaka, mpi kaka na ntangu yina yo ke sala mabaku ya mpa sambu na bantu ya ke salaka bilanga na bisika ya nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The overall effect is that the global agricultural system is becoming more complex and less predictable.
target_text: Bupusi na yo ya mvimba kele nde ngidika ya mvimba ya bilanga ke kuma mindondo mpi mpasi mingi na kubakisa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One of the most direct effects of climate change on agriculture is the increase in the frequency and severity of extreme weather events.
target_text: Bupusi mosi ya ngolo ya nsoba ya klima kele ti yo na bisalu ya bilanga kele kumata ya bambala mambu ya ntangu ya ngolo ke salama mpi ngolo na yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Heat waves, droughts, floods, and storms can all damage crops and livestock, and make it difficult for farmers to get their crops to market.
target_text: Bitembo ya tiya, nsungi ya kuyuma, kufuluka ya masa, mpi mipepe ya ngolo, nyonso lenda bebisa bimenia mpi bitwisi, mpi kusala nde yo vanda mpasi sambu bantu ya ke salaka bilanga kunata bima na bo na bazandu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In some cases, these events can cause entire crop yields to be lost, leading to food shortages and price increases.
target_text: Na bambandu ya nkaka, mambu yai sala nde bima yonso kubeba, kusala nde bantu kukonda madia mpi ntalu ya bima kumata.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In addition to extreme weather events, climate change is also leading to changes in the average temperature and precipitation patterns.
target_text: Katula bantangu ya ngolo, nsoba ya klima ke nata mpi na nsoba na ngolo ya ntangu mpi na mutindu mvula ke nokaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These changes are making it more difficult to grow some crops in certain areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.
target_text: Bansoba yai ke sala nde yo vanda mpasi sambu bima kuyela na bisika ya nkaka, kansi kaka na ntangu yina mosi yo ke basisa mabaku ya mpa sambu na bantu ya ke salaka bilanga na bisika ya nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: For example, the warmer temperatures in some areas are making it possible to grow crops that were previously not possible, while the increased precipitation in other areas is making it possible to grow crops that were previously not feasible.
target_text: Mu mbandu, bantangu ya ngolo na bisika ya nkaka ke sadisa na kuyedisa bima yina yo vandaka mpasi na kuyedisa na bilumbu me luta, kansi mutindu mvula ke noka mingi na bisika ya nkaka ke sadisa na kuyedisa bima yina yo vandaka mpasi na kuyebisa na ntama.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I was driving home from work one day when I got cut off by another driver.
target_text: Mono vandaka kuvutuka na nzo na kamio na nima ya kisalu ntangu shofere ya nkaka zengaka mono nzila.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I was so angry that I started tailgating him and flashing my lights.
target_text: Mono dasukaka yo yina mono yantikaka kupusana mpenza pene-pene na yandi mpi kupesa bamwinda ya kamio.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He just kept driving slower and slower, and I was getting more and more frustrated.

source_text: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful river that flowed through a lush forest.

source_text: The river was also a popular spot for humans to swim, fish, and relax.

source_text: One day, a young girl named Lily was playing near the river when she saw a turtle caught in a fishing net.

source_text: Lily knew that she had to help the turtle, so she ran home to get her father.

source_text: The turtle thanked Lily for saving her life, and Lily promised to always be kind to animals.

source_text: Lily continued to visit the river often, and she always made sure to look out for any animals that might be in danger.

source_text: One day, Lily saw a group of boys throwing rocks at the fish in the river.

source_text: Lily knew that she had to stop them, so she ran up to the boys and told them that what they were doing was wrong.

source_text: The boys were surprised to hear this from Lily, but they listened to her and stopped throwing rocks.

source_text: "What is the meaning of becoming a queen?" asked the young woman.

source_text: "It is to learn to accommodate all that is," said the old woman.

source_text: "To hold in your heart the beauty and the pain, the joy and the sorrow, the light and the darkness.To see the world as it is, and to love it nonetheless."
target_text: "Sambu na kubumba na ntina na nge kitoko mpi mpasi, kiese mpi mawa, nsemo mpi mudidi. Sambu na kumona nsi-ntoto mutindu yo kele, mpi sambu na kuzola yo mpila yo kele."

source_text: "But how can I do that?" asked the young woman. "The world is so full of suffering."
target_text: Leke ya nkento yulaka nde, "Kansi nki mutindu mono lenda sala yo?" "Nsi-ntoto me fuluka ti bampasi."

source_text: "Yes, it is," said the old woman.

source_text: "But it is also full of beauty. And it is our task to find the beauty in the suffering, and to let it transform us.

source_text: "When you become a queen, you will have power.

source_text: But power is not a thing to be used for your own gain.

source_text: It is a responsibility to be used for the good of others.

source_text: You must learn to use your power to heal the world, not to harm it.

source_text: You must also learn to be humble.

source_text: A queen is not above others, but she is also not below them."
target_text: Mfumu ya nkento kele ve na zulu ya bantu ya nkaka, kansi yandi kele mpi ve na nsi na bo."

source_text: Cricket is a game played with a bat and ball between two teams of eleven players on a field at the centre of which is a 22-yard pitch with a wicket at each end, each comprising two bails balanced on three stumps.
target_text: Cricket kele nsaka ya bo ke bulaka ti batte mpi ballon na baekipe zole ya bajoueur onze na terrain mosi yina katikati na yo kele kibansala ya 22 yards ti guiched mosi na konso nsuka, konso guichet kele ti babails zole na equilibre na zulu ya basouche tatu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The game proceeds when a player on the fielding team, called the bowler, bowls the ball from one end of the pitch towards the wicket at the other end, with an opposing player called the batsman attempting to strike the ball with his bat so that it travels far enough to allow him to run between the wickets, scoring runs.
target_text: Nsaka ke bandaka ntangu joueur ya ekipe ya ke defendre, ya bo ke bingaka lanceur, ke bula ballon katuka na ndambu mosi ya terrain sambu yo kwenda na ba guichets yina kele na ndambu ya nkaka. Joueur ya ekipe ya zole, ya bo ke bingaka batteur, ke mekaka kubula ballon yina ti batte na yandi sambu yo kwenda na kitamina ya nda mpenza sambu yo sadisa yandi na kubaka ntinu na katikati ya ba guichets mpi kutula matonsi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The fielding side tries to prevent this by stopping the ball with their own bats, with their hands or with the wicket itself and then throwing the ball back to the bowler.
target_text: Ekipe ya ke defendre ke mekaka kukanga yo na kukangaka ballon ti babate na yandi, maboko na yandi to na guichet yo mosi, na nima na kuvutulaka yo kisika ya muntu yina bulaka yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Cricket is a game that requires a lot of skill and practice.
target_text: Cricket kele nsaka yina ke lombaka mayele mpi ngalasisi mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It can be a very rewarding game, but it also takes a lot of hard work.
target_text: Yo lenda vanda nsaka ya kiese mingi, kansi yo ke lombaka ngolo mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If you want to be a good cricketer, you need to be honest with yourself about your abilities and be willing to put in the time and effort to train.
target_text: Kana nge ke zola kuvanda joueur ya mbote ya cricket, nge fwete vanda masonga ti nge mosi na yina me tala makuki na nge mpi luzolo na nge ya kusadila ntangu mpi kikesa sambu na kusala formation.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Vegetarian cuisine encompasses a wide variety of dishes and ingredients that are prepared without the use of meat, poultry, or fish.
target_text: Madia ya ndunda kele madi ya mutindu na mutindu ya bo ke lambaka kuzanga kusadla musuni ya mbisi, ya ndeke to ya mbisi ya masa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: While some vegetarians avoid all animal products, including dairy and eggs, others may consume dairy or eggs but not meat.
target_text: Ata bantu ya nkaka ya ke diaka bandunda ke buyaka bima yonso ya me katuka na bambisi, ata mpi miliki na maki, bankaka lenda dia miliki to maki kansi musuni ve.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are many reasons why people choose to adopt a vegetarian diet, including ethical concerns about the treatment of animals, environmental concerns about the impact of animal agriculture on the planet, and health concerns about the consumption of meat.
target_text: Yo kele ti bikuma mingi ya ke pusaka bantu na kudia kaka bandunda, ata mpi mambu ya bikalulu ya mbote na yina me tala mpila bo ke sadilaka bambisi mambu, basusi ya mupepe na yina me tala bupusi ya kusansa bambisi kele ti yo na plantete, mpi basusi ya santé na yina me tala kudia misuni.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Vegetarian food can be just as delicious and satisfying as meat-based dishes, and there are a number of ways to incorporate plant-based proteins into your diet.
target_text: Madia ya bandunda lenda vanda ntomo mpi kitoko kaka bonso madia ya bo me lamba ti musuni, mpi yo kele ti mitindu mingi ya kuyika baproteine ya me katuka na bandunda na madia na nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Some popular vegetarian proteins include beans, lentils, tofu, tempeh, and seitan.
target_text: Ndambu ya baproteine ya bandunda ya me zabanaka kele madesu, lentilles, tofu, tempeh, mpi seitan.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are also a number of meat substitutes available on the market, such as veggie burgers, chicken nuggets, and soy-based hot dogs.
target_text: Yo kele mpi ti bima yina lenda yinga misuni na zandu, mu mbandu ba hamburger ya bandunda, ba nuggets ya nsusu, mpi ba hot dog ya me salama na soya.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If you're new to vegetarian cooking, there are a number of resources available to help you get started.

notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: There are cookbooks, websites, and blogs dedicated to vegetarian cuisine, and there are also a number of cooking classes available.

notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: With a little creativity and experimentation, you can easily create delicious and satisfying vegetarian meals for yourself and your family.
target_text: Kana nge ke sadila mayele na nge mpi ke meka-meka, nge lenda lamba na pete yonso madia ya ntomo mpi ya kitoko ya bandunda sambu na nge mosi mpi dibuta na nge.

source_text: In a large bowl, combine the oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.

source_text: As we started to hike back down, we realized that the view was even better from below.
target_text: Ntangu beto yantikaka kukulumuka, beto bakisaka nde kisika yango vandaka kitoko mingi na kutala katuka na nsi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: We could see the truck in the distance, and it looked like a tiny speck.
target_text: Beto vandaka kumona kamio yina na ntama, mpi yo vandaka kumonana bonso ka kima ya fioti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It was amazing to think that we had just been up there, looking down at it.
target_text: Yo vandaka kitoko mingi na kuyindula nde beto vandaka kuna na zulu, beto ke tala yo katuka na zulu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The hike down was easier than the hike up, and we made it back to our car in no time.
target_text: Kukulumuka vandaka pete kuluta kumata, mpi beto kumaka kisika kamio na beto vandaka kukonda kuwumela.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: On April 24, 1980, eight U.S. helicopters carrying Delta Force and other U.S. special operations troops launched from the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz.
target_text: Na le 24 avril 1980, bahelicoptere nana ya Etats-Unis yina vandaka kunata basoda ya Delta Force mpi basoda ya nkaka ya speciale ya Etats-Unis bandaka voyage na porte-avion USS Nimitz.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The helicopters were supposed to land at the U.S.
target_text: Bahelicoptere zolaka kukulumukana ambasade ya Etats-Unis.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Embassy in Tehran, where they would rescue the hostages.
target_text: Na Teheran, kisika yo zolaka kugulusa bantu yina bo kangaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: However, one of the helicopters crashed in the desert, killing eight U.S. servicemen.
target_text: Kansi, helicoptere mosi panzaka na desert, yo fwaka basoda ya Etats-Unis nana.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The remaining helicopters were forced to abort the mission.
target_text: Yo pusaka bahelicoptere yina bikalaka na kuyambula kisalu ya bo tindaka bo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The failed rescue attempt was a major embarrassment for the Carter administration.
target_text: Mutindu bo nungaka ve na kugulusa bantu vandaka nsoni ya nene sambu na kisalu ya Carter.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It also damaged America’s reputation in the world.
target_text: Yo bebisaka mpi lukumu ya Etats-Unis na ntoto ya mvimba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In the aftermath of the failed rescue attempt, Carter ordered a boycott of Iranian oil.
target_text: Na nima ya kisalu yina ya kugulusa bantu ya bo nungaka ve, Carter tubaka bo fwete sadila ve petrole to esance ya Iran.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: He also imposed economic sanctions on Iran.
target_text: Yandi pesaka Iran bandola ya mambu ya mbongo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The Iranian government released the hostages on January 20, 1981, just minutes after Ronald Reagan was sworn in as President of the United States.
target_text: Luyalu ya Iran yambulaka bantu ya bo kangaka na le 20 janvier 1981, miniti fioti na nima ya ntangu yina Ronald Reagan diaka ndefi bonso Prezida ya Etats-Unis.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The noble steed, a symbol of strength and grace, has been a mainstay of human civilization for millennia.
target_text: Mpunda ya lukumu, kidimbu ya ngolo mpi ya ngemba me kumaka kima ya mfunu na luzingu ya bantu banda bamvula mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: From the battlefields of antiquity to the modern racetrack, horses have played a vital role in our history.
target_text: Banda na bisika ya bamvita ya ntangu ya ntama tii na bisika ya bo ke bakaka ntinu ya bubu yai, bampuda me salaka kisalu ya nene na luzingu na beto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: But what is it about horses that makes them so special?
target_text: Kansi nki yango ya me tala bampunda yina ke salaka nde yo vanda speciale?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: What is it that draws us to these magnificent creatures?
target_text: Inki ke benddaka beto na bigangwa yai ya kuyituka?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Perhaps it is their beauty, with their sleek coats and flowing manes.
target_text: Mbala ya nkaka yo kele kitoko na yo, ti bakazaka na yo ya kitoko mpi nsuki na yo ya me kulumuka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Perhaps it is their strength, as they can carry us on their backs for miles.
target_text: Mbala ya nkaka yo kele ngolo na yo, mutindu yo ke nataka beto na mukongo na yo na bakilometre mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Or perhaps it is their intelligence, as they are capable of learning a wide variety of tasks.
target_text: To mbala ya nkaka mayele na yo, muitndu bo ke kukaka kulonguka bisalu ya mutindu na mutindu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Whatever the reason, there is no denying the bond that exists between humans and horses.
target_text: Yo vnada nki yango ke bendaka beto, ntembe kele ve nde kuwakana kele na kati ya bantu mpi bampunda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They are truly partners in life, and their companionship is a gift to be cherished.
target_text: Bo kele mpenza banduku ya luzingu, mpi kinduku na bo kele dikabu ya beto fwete baka na mbalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: One of the most remarkable things about horses is their ability to sense our emotions.
target_text: Mosi ya mambu ya mfunu mingi ya me tala bampunda kele mayele na yo ya kubakisa mawi na beto.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They can tell when we are happy, sad, or scared, and they will often respond in kind.
target_text: Yo lenda zaba kana beto kele na kiese, na mawa, ke wa boma, mpi mbala mingi yo ke salaka mambu na mawete.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This makes them ideal companions for people who are lonely or who need emotional support.
target_text: Yo ke salaka nde yo vanda banduku ya me fwana sambu na bantu yina kele bo mosi to yina kele ti mfunu ya lusadisu ya mawi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: In addition to their companionship, horses can also be used for a variety of purposes.
target_text: Katula kinduku na bo, bampunda lenda sadilama sambu na bikuma mingi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They can be ridden for pleasure, used for work, or even raced.
target_text: Bo lenda tambusa yo sambu na kiese, kusadila yo sambu na kisalu, to nkutu sambu na kusala nsaka ya ntinu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grandma: What can I help you with today, my dear?
target_text: Nkaka ya nkento: Sheri, mono lenda sadisa nge na nki bubu yai?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grandchild: I'm feeling really unmotivated.
target_text: Mutekolo ya nkento: Mono ke kudiwa mpenza kukonda kikesa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I have a lot of work to do, but I can't seem to get started.
target_text: Mono kele ti bisalu mingi, kansi mono ke kuka ve kuyantika.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grandma: I know how you feel.
target_text: Nkaka ya nkento: Mono me zaba mpila nge ke kudiwa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Sometimes, motivation can be hard to come by.
target_text: Bantangu ya nkaka, yo ke vandaka mpasi na kuvanda ti kikesa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: But there are a few things you can do to help yourself get started.
target_text: Kansi yo kele ti mwa mambu yina nge lenda sala sambu yo sadisa nge na kuyantika.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: First, think about why you're doing the work.
target_text: Ya ntete, yindula sambu na nki nge ke sala kisalu.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: What's your goal?
target_text: Inki kele lukanu na nge?
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Once you know what you're working towards, it's easier to stay motivated.
target_text: Kana nge me zaba balukanu na nge, yo ta vanda pete na kuvanda ti kikesa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Second, break down the task into smaller steps.
target_text: Ya zole, kabisa kisalu na bitambi ya fioti-fioti.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This will make it seem less daunting and more manageable.
target_text: Yo ta sala nde yo monana mpasi mingi mpi pete na kusala yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Third, give yourself rewards for completing each step.
target_text: Ya tatu, kudipesa kado na nima ya kumanisa konso kitambi.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: This will help you stay on track and motivated.
target_text: Yo ta sadisa nge na kubikala na nzila mpi kuvidisa ve kikesa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Finally, don't be afraid to ask for help if you need it.
target_text: Ya nsuka, kuwa ve boma ya kulomba lusadisu kana nge kele ti mfunu na yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Sometimes, all you need is a little encouragement to get you started.
target_text: Bantangu ya nkaka, kima ya nge kele ti mfunu na yo kele kaka mwa kikesa sambu nge yantika.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grandchild: Thank you, Grandma.
target_text: Mutekolo: Mersi, nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I'll try those things.
target_text: Mono ta meka bima yai.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Grandma: You're welcome, my dear.
target_text: Nkaka ya nkento: Kima, sheri.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: I'm always here for you.
target_text: Mono kele ntangu yonso awa sambu na nge.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Rental cars are a convenient way to get around when visiting a new city or country.
target_text: Kamio ya ku louer kele mutindu ya mbote ya kutambula ntangu nge ke kwenda kutala mbanza to insi ya mpa.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They offer the flexibility to explore at your own pace and can be a more affordable option than public transportation.
target_text: Yo ke sadisaka na kutala kisika mpila nge me zola mpie yo lenda vanda ntangu fioti kuluta transport ya bantu yonso.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When renting a car, it is important to compare prices from different companies and to read the fine print of the rental agreement carefully.
target_text: Ntangu nge ke louer kamio, yo kele mfunu na kufwanisa bantalu na bakompani ya kuswaswana mpi na kutanga mbote mambu ya bo me sonika na mukanda ya ku louer kamio.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: Be sure to ask about any additional fees, such as fuel charges, insurance, or tolls.
target_text: Kuvila ve na kuyula bambongo ya nkaka yina yo ta lomba kufuta, mu mbandu mbongo ya carburant, assurance to peage.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is also a good idea to take pictures of the car before you drive it away, so that you have proof of its condition in case of any damage.
target_text: Yo kele mpi mbote na kubaka bafoto ya kamio na ntwala yo kubaka yo, sambu nge vanda ti preuve ya mutindu yo vandaka kana yo me beba na nima.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If you are planning to rent a car for an extended period of time, you may be able to get a better deal by purchasing a rental car package.
target_text: Kana nge ke kana ku louer kamio sambu na nsungi ya nda, nge lenda baka yo na ntalu ya mbote kana nge sumba forfait ya ku louer kamio.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: These packages typically include a set number of days of rental, as well as unlimited mileage and other extras.
target_text: Baforfait yai ke vandaka mbala mingi ti mwa ndambu ya bilumbu ya kufutila, bakilometre ya kukonda ndilu mpi mambote ya nkaka.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You may also be able to get a discount if you book your rental car in advance.
target_text: Bo lenda kitisila nge mpi ntalu kana louer kamio na ntwala.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: When picking up your rental car, be sure to inspect it carefully for any damage.
target_text: Ntangu nge ke baka kamio ya nge me louer, kuvila nge na kutala mbote konso kisika ya kubeba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: If you see any damage, be sure to note it on the rental agreement.
target_text: Kana nge me mona kisika ya kubeba, kuvila ve na kusonika yo na mukanda ya ku louer kamio.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: You should also take pictures of the car before you drive it away.
target_text: Nge fwete baka mpi bafoto ya kamio na ntwala nde nge kwenda ti yo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The Uganda Martyrs are a group of 23 Anglican and 22 Roman Catholic Christians who were killed between 1885 and 1887.
target_text: Bamartyre ya Ouganda kele kimvuka Ba anglican 23 mpi Bantu 22 ya Katolika ya Roma yina bo fwaka na kati ya bamvu 1885 mpi 1887.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They were killed by the king of Buganda, Mwanga II, for refusing to renounce their faith.
target_text: Bo fwaka bo na ntotila Buganda, Mwanga II, sambu bo buyaka kuyambula lukwikilu na bo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The martyrs were canonized by Pope Paul VI in 1964.
target_text: Pape Paul VI kumisaka bo basangu na 1964.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They are considered to be among the most important figures in the history of Christianity in Uganda.
target_text: Bo kele na kati ya bantu ya mfunu mingi ya disolo ya Bukristu na Ouganda.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The Uganda Martyrs' Day is celebrated on June 3rd every year.
target_text: Bo ke salaka fete ya kilumbu ya Bamartyre ya Ouganda na le 3 juin konso mvula.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: It is a national holiday in Uganda and is observed by Christians all over the world.
target_text: Yo kele feti ya insi ya mvimba na Ouganda mpi Bakristu ke salaka yo na ntoto ya mvimba.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: The martyrs are remembered for their courage and their willingness to die for their faith.
target_text: Bo ke yibukaka bamartyre sambu na kikesa na bo mpi luzolo na bo ya kufwa sambu na lukwikilu na bo.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.

source_text: They are an inspiration to Christians everywhere.
target_text: Bo ke pesaka bangindu ya mbote na Bakristu ya bisika yonso.
notes: Authentic SMOL source accepted as supplied; retain known Kituba quality warning.
